source: Red tide به علت غلظت بالاتر از حد نورمال Karenia brevis که یک ارگانیزم بحری یک حجروی طبیعی است، بوجود می آید.
english_gold: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.
english_hypothesis: Red tide is caused by the presence of Karenia brevis, a naturally occurring marine organism, at concentrations higher than normal.

source: فکتور های طبیعی میتواند باهم تقاطع کنند تا شرایط دلخواه را ایجاد کند و به این ترتیب تعداد این الجی بصورت چشمگیری افزایش یابد.
english_gold: Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically.
english_hypothesis: Natural factors can intersect with each other to create desired conditions, thereby significantly increasing the number of this entity.

source: این الجی نیوروتوکسین را تولید میکند که اعصاب را در هر دو انسان ها و ماهی ها غیرفعال کرده میتواند.
english_gold: The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish.
english_hypothesis: This neurotoxin can paralyze nerves in both humans and fish.

source: ماهی ها معمولاً به علت غلظت های بالای توکسین در آب ها میمیرند.
english_gold: Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters.
english_hypothesis: Fish usually die due to high levels of toxins in the water.

source: انسان ها با تنفس آب آلوده که توسط باد و امواج به هوا انتقال یافته است، متاثر گردیده میتواند.
english_gold: Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.
english_hypothesis: Humans can be affected by breathing in polluted air that has been carried by wind and waves.

source: برای بازگشت به سطح انرژی قبلی خود، آنها باید انرژی اضافی دریافت شده از آن را از بین ببرند.
english_gold: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.
english_hypothesis: To return to their previous energy level, they must eliminate the excess energy they have received.

source: آنها این کار را با انتشار نور و ذرات کوچک به نام "فوتون" انجام می دهند.
english_gold: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".
english_hypothesis: They do this by releasing light and small particles called "photons".

source: دانشمندان این فرآیند را "انتشار محرک تابش" می نامند زیرا اتوم ها با نور شدید تحریک می شوند ، نور فوتون ها را منتشر می کند و نور نوعی تابش است.
english_gold: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.
english_hypothesis: Scientists refer to this process as "stimulated emission of radiation" because atoms are excited by intense light, emit photons, and radiation is a form of emission.

source: تصویر بعدی انتشار فوتون های اتومی را نشان می دهد. البته عکسها در واقع بسیار کوچکتر از عکس هستند.
english_gold: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.
english_hypothesis: The next image shows the emission of atomic photons.

source: فوتون ها حتی کوچکتر از چیزهایی هستند که اتوم می سازند!
english_gold: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!
english_hypothesis: Photons are even smaller than the things they create!

source: عناصر و ترکیبات می توانند از یک حالت به حالت دیگر تبدیل شده و تغییر نکنند.
english_gold: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.
english_hypothesis: Elements and compounds can be transformed from one state to another and remain unchanged.

source: گاز نایتروجن هنوز همان خواص نایتروجن مایع را دارد. حالت مایع آن متراکم تر است اما مالیکول های آن هنوز یکسان هستند.
english_gold: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.
english_hypothesis: Nitrogen gas still retains the properties of liquid nitrogen. Its liquid state is denser, but its molecules remain the same.

source: آب نمونه ای دیگر است، آب ترکیب دو اتم هیدروجن و یک اتم اکسیجن می باشد.
english_gold: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
english_hypothesis: Water is another example, water is a combination of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

source: دارای ساختمان مالیکولی یکسان می باشد چه گاز، چه مایع و چه جامد باشد.
english_gold: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.
english_hypothesis: This sentence translates to: "It has the same molecular structure, regardless of whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid."

source: اگرچه حالت فیزیکی آن ممکن تغییر بکند، اما حالت کیمیایی آن ثابت می ماند.
english_gold: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.
english_hypothesis: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains constant.

source: این را pH کیمیاوی می نامند. می توانید با استفاده از آب کباب سرخ یک شاخص را تهیه کنید.
english_gold: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
english_hypothesis: They call this the "chemical pH." You can make an indicator by using the juice of a red cabbage.

source: رنگ آب کباب بسته به میزان اسیدی یا اساسی بودن (قلیایی) این ماده کیمیاوی تغییر می کند.
english_gold: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
english_hypothesis: The color of kebab water changes depending on the acidic or basic nature of this chemical substance.

source: سطح pH با مقدار یونهای هایدروجن (H) در ماده کیمیاوی مورد آزمایش مشخص می شود.
english_gold: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
english_hypothesis: The pH level of a substance is determined by the amount of hydrogen ions (H+) present in it.

source: یونهای هایدروجن پروتونهایی هستند که الکترونهای آنها از آنها جدا شده است (زیرا اتومهای هایدروجن دارای یک پروتون و یک الکترون هستند).
english_gold: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
english_hypothesis: Hydrogen ions are protons that have lost their electrons (since hydrogen atoms have one proton and one electron).

source: این فقط این را تایید نمی کند که حد اقل بعضی از داینسور ها پر داشتند که یک نظریه از قبل رایج شده است، مگر توضیحات را فراهم می سازد که فوسیل ها نمی توانند، مانند رنگ و ترتیب سه بعدی.
english_gold: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
english_hypothesis: This only confirms that at least some of the dinosaurs were filled, which is a theory that has been widely accepted, but it also provides explanations for why fossils cannot, like color and three-dimensional order.

source: دانشمندان می گویند که پر های این حیوان در قسمت بالا دارای رنگ نصواری است و در قسمت پائین دارای رنگ کمرنگ زرد یا نارنجی است.
english_gold: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
english_hypothesis: Scientists say that the wings of this animal have a mottled coloration on the upper part and a pale yellow or orange coloration on the lower part.

source: این یافته همچنان به تکامل پر ها در پرندگان نیز کمک میکند.
english_gold: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
english_hypothesis: This finding also contributes to the evolution of wings in birds.

source: اینکه پر ها داینسور دارای یک محور توسعه یافته که بنام رچیز یاد می شوند نیست، بلکه دارای خواص پر ها نیز نیست – خار و موی کوچک – محققان دریافتند که رچیز احتمالا یک انکشاف انقلابی بعدی بود که این یک ویژگی دیگری است.
english_gold: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
english_hypothesis: The discovery of the rachis, a developed axis of the pterosaur, was not a characteristic of the pterosaur, but rather a feature of the feathers, which were small and hair-like. Researchers found that the rachis was likely a revolutionary development, another characteristic of the pterosaur.

source: ساختار پر نشان میدهد که آنها در پرواز استفاده نمی شدند مگر بمنظور تنظیم درجه حرارت یا نمایش. محققان پیشنهاد کردنند که اگرچه این دم یک داینسور جوان است، مگر این نمونه پر های جوان را نشان میدهد نه پر های چوچه را.
english_gold: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
english_hypothesis: The structure suggests that these feathers were not used for flight, but rather for temperature regulation or display purposes. Researchers propose that although this is a juvenile dinosaur, the presence of juvenile feathers rather than quill knobs indicates that feathers were present in this individual.

source: تاثیر که تیم در تلاش آن بود ممکن به علت قوه موجی میان ماده تاریک کهکشان و ماده تاریک راه شیر باشد.
english_gold: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
english_hypothesis: The effect that the team was trying to achieve may be due to the wave-like interaction between dark matter in the Andromeda galaxy and dark matter in the Milky Way.

source: طوریکه مهتاب بالای زمین ضربه وارد میکند، باعث تشکیل امواج می گردد، به همین طور راه شیری بالای کهکشان قوی قوه وارد میکند.
english_gold: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
english_hypothesis: The moon, as it strikes the earth, creates waves. In the same manner, the Milky Way, with its powerful force, strikes the galaxy.

source: دانشمندان توانستند نتیجه گیری نمایند که یک ماده تاریک ماده تاریک دیگری مانند ماده منظم تحت تاثیر قرار دهد.
english_gold: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
english_hypothesis: Scientists have been able to conclude that dark matter can affect dark matter, just like regular matter.

source: این تیوری میگوید که بیشترین ماده تاریک اطراف کهکشان در اطراف کهکشان نوع حلقه نور موقعیت دارد و از اجزای کوچک زیاد ساخته شده است.
english_gold: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
english_hypothesis: This theory states that the majority of dark matter surrounding the galaxy is located in the vicinity of the ring-shaped galaxy and is composed of numerous small components.

source: هم سیانوریک اسید و میلامین در نمونه های ادرار حیوانات که بعد از مصرف غذای ملوس شده شان مردند پیدا شد.
english_gold: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
english_hypothesis: Sianuric acid and milamine were found in the urine samples of animals that died after consuming spoiled food.

source: محققین در پوهنتون میگوید، این دو مرکب با هم تعامل میکنند تا کریستال های تشکیل دهد که شاید فعالیت گرده را متوقف نماید.
english_gold: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
english_hypothesis: Scientists at the university say that these two compounds interact with each other to form crystals that may stop pollen activity.

source: محققین کریستال های را مشاهده کرد که در ادرار پشک با علاوه کردن میلامین و سیانوریک اسید بوجود آمده بودند.
english_gold: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
english_hypothesis: Researchers observed crystals in the urine of patients who had been administered both milammine and cyanuric acid.

source: ترکیب این کریستال ها با آنهای که در ادرار حیوانات متأثر شده پیدا شد یکسان بود زمانیکه توسط طیف نما فرو بنفش (FTIR) مقایسه شد.
english_gold: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
english_hypothesis: The combination of these crystals with those affected by the urine of animals was found to be the same when compared using Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR).

source: زمانیکه یک گروه کوچک موجودات زنده (یک جمیعت کوچک) از جماعت اصلی که آنها مربوط اش میشود جدا میشود (مثلاً اگر آنها بطرف یک سلسله کوه یا دریا حرکت کنند، یا اگر آنها بطرف یک جزیره جدید حرکت کنند تا بتوانند دوباره به راحتی برگردند) آنها محیط متفاوت را در مقایسه با محیط قبلی شاهد خواهند بود.
english_gold: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
english_hypothesis: When a small group of living beings (a small community) separates from the main group they belong to (for example, if they move towards a mountain range or a sea, or if they move towards a new island so they can easily return), they will witness a different environment compared to their previous one.

source: محیط جدید منابع متفاوت و رقیبان متفاوت دارد، از اینرو جمیعت جدید به ویژگی های متفاوت یا سازگاری ها جهت اینکه یک رقیب قوی در مقایسه با چیزی که بودند باشند نیاز دارند.
english_gold: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
english_hypothesis: The new environment has different resources and competitors, so the new population needs different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor compared to what they were before.

source: بالاخره، بعد از هزارها یا حتی میلیون ها سال، دو جمیعت چنان با هم متفاوت خواهند بود که دیگر یک نوع خوانده نخواهند شد.
english_gold: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
english_hypothesis: Finally, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will be so different from each other that they will no longer be considered the same species.

source: ما این پروسه را شکل گیری مینامیم، که معنی اش فقط تشکیل یک نوع جدید است. شکل گیری یک نتیجه غیرقابل جلوگیری و یک بخش مهم تکامل است.
english_gold: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
english_hypothesis: We are shaping this process, which simply means the formation of a new type. Formation is an inevitable result and an important part of evolution.

source: موزازورهای شکارچیهای اوج زمان خود بودند، بجز موزازورهای دیگر، از هیچ چیزی نمی ترسیدند.
english_gold: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
english_hypothesis: They were the hunters of their time, except for other Moazazurs, they feared nothing.

source: الاشه ی طویل اش با بیش از 70 دندان تیغ-مانند، همراه یک ست اضافی در سقف دهانش پرکاری شده بود. به این معنی که هیچ چیزی نمیتواند از مسیر آن راه فرار نماید.
english_gold: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
english_hypothesis: The long, serrated ash with over 70 teeth-like protrusions, accompanied by an additional row in the roof of its mouth, had become so dense that nothing could escape its path.

source: دقیقاً نمیفهمیم، اما احتمالاً دارای زبان خاردار بوده، رژیم غذایی آن شامل سنگ پشت ها، ماهیان بزرگ، دیگر انواع موزازورها و حتی ممکن است ادمخوارد بوده باشد.
english_gold: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
english_hypothesis: We may not fully understand, but it is likely that it had a spiky language. Its diet consisted of stingrays, large fish, other types of mosaasaurs, and possibly even plesiosaurs.

source: این همچنان به هر چیزی که داخل آب میشد حمله میکرد؛ حتی یک دایناسور عظیم الجسه مانند T.rex نظیر اش نخواهد بود.
english_gold: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
english_hypothesis: This would still attack anything that went into the water; even a massive dinosaur like T.rex would not be similar to it.

source: حشرات اولین حیواناتی بودند که به هوا پرواز کردند. توانایی پرواز به آنها کمک کرد تا به راحتی از دست دشمنان فرار کنند و غذا و جفت خود را با موثریت بیشتری بیابند.
english_gold: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
english_hypothesis: Insects were the first animals to fly in the air. Their ability to fly allowed them to easily escape from enemies and find food and mates with greater effectiveness.

source: اکثر حشرات دارای مزیت خم کردن بالهایشان در امتداد بدن به عقب می باشند.
english_gold: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
english_hypothesis: Most insects have the advantage of folding their wings along their body towards the back.

source: این به آنها طیف گسترده تری از مکان های کوچکتر برای پنهان شدن از شکارچیان را میدهد.
english_gold: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
english_hypothesis: This gives them a wider range of smaller places to hide from hunters.

source: امروزه، تنها حشراتي كه نمي توانند بالهای خود را به عقب خم كنند، سنجاقک ها و آسیابک ها می باشند.
english_gold: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
english_hypothesis: Today, only the dragonflies and damselflies are unable to fold their wings backwards.

source: جهان دارای بیش از 5000 زبان مختلف، شامل بیش از بیست زبان با 50 میلیون متکلم یا بیشتر است.
english_gold: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.
english_hypothesis: The world has more than 5000 different languages, including more than 20 languages with over 50 million speakers.

source: برآورد های متفاوت برای شمار افرادی که به زبان هندی صحبت وجود دارد. تخمین شده است که بین دومین و چهارمین زبان رایج در دنیا باشد.
english_gold: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.
english_hypothesis: Estimates vary for the number of people who speak Hindi. It is estimated to be the second or fourth most widely spoken language in the world.

source: تعداد گویندگان اصلی نظر به شمارش یا عدم شمارش لهجه های نزدیک، متفاوت است.
english_gold: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.
english_hypothesis: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not to count dialects.

source: اندازه برآوردها از 340 میلیون تا 500 میلیون گوینده در حال تغییر است، و تا حدود 800 میلیون نفر می توانند این زبان را بفهمند.
english_gold: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.
english_hypothesis: The estimates of the number of speakers range from 340 million to 500 million, and it is estimated that up to 800 million people can understand this language.

source: هندی و اردو در کلمات مشابه هم استند اما از نگاه خط متفاوت هستند؛ در مکالمات روزمره، گویندگان هردو زبان به سادگی میتوانند یکدیگر را درک کنند.
english_gold: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.
english_hypothesis: Hindi and Urdu are similar in words but differ in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can easily understand each other.

source: بینظمی کمبود توجه "یک سندرم عصبی است که سه علامت کلاسیک آن شامل هوس خواهی حواس پرتی و بیش فعالی یا انرژی اضافی است."
english_gold: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".
english_hypothesis: Attention Deficit Disorder (ADD) is a neurological syndrome characterized by three classic symptoms: distractibility, impulsivity, and excessive energy.

source: این یک معیوبیت یادگیری نیست، این یک بیظمی یادگیری است. این "3 تا 5 درصد از همه کودکان، شاید به اندازه 2 میلیون کودک آمریکایی" را شامل می سازد.
english_gold: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".
english_hypothesis: This is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder. It includes "3 to 5 percent of all children, possibly as many as 2 million American children."

source: این کودکان معمولاٌ درگیر مشکلات زیادی می شوند، زیرا برای تحریک مغز خود <درگیر رفتارهای پرخطر، دعوا، و به چالش کشیدن قدرت> می شوند، زیرا مغز آنها با روش های عادی تحریک نمی شود.

english_hypothesis: Spirituality can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on direct, personal experience of a unique state of awareness, particularly those characterized by peacefulness, blessed insight, or even ecstasy.

source: طرح های تفکر همگرا تخنیک های حل مسئله هستند که تفکرات یا بخش های مختلف را برای پیدا کردن یک راه حل متحد میسازد.
english_gold: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.
english_hypothesis: Convergent thinking techniques are problem-solving methods that unite various thoughts or parts to find a solution.

source: تمرکز این طرز فکر سرعت، منطق و درستی، همچنان شناسایی حقایق، دوباره بکار بردن تخنیکهای کنونی، جمع آوری معلومات است.
english_gold: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.
english_hypothesis: This line of thinking emphasizes speed, logic, and correctness, as well as fact-checking, reusing current techniques, and gathering information.

source: مهمترین عامل این ذهنیت عبارت است از: تنها یک جواب درست وجود دارد. شما صرف به دو جواب فکر میکنید، یعنی درست یا غلط.
english_gold: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.
english_hypothesis: The most important factor in this mindset is that there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, right or wrong.

source: این نوع تفکر با علم خاص یا طرزالعمل های استندرد مرتبط است.
english_gold: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.
english_hypothesis: This type of thinking is associated with a specific science or set of standard procedures.

source: مردم دارای چنین شیوه تفکر منطقی می اندیشند، توانایی بحافطه سپردن طرحها، حل مشکلات و کار روی تست های علمی را دارا می باشند.
english_gold: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.
english_hypothesis: People have such a logical way of thinking, they are able to present their ideas, solve problems, and work on scientific tests.

source: ارتباط غیرهمزمان مجال را برای تأمل و واکنش به دیگران ترغیب می کند.
english_gold: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.
english_hypothesis: This sentence translates to: "Asynchronous communication provides an opportunity for contemplation and reaction to others."

source: این کار محصلین را قادر میسازد تا با سرعت خودشان کار کنند و آهنگ معلومات آموزشی را کنترل کنند.
english_gold: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.
english_hypothesis: This allows students to work at their own pace and control the rhythm of their educational information.

source: بعلاوه محدودیت های زمانی کمتری با امکان ساعت های کاری انعطاف پذیر وجود دارد. (برمر، 1998)
english_gold: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)
english_hypothesis: In addition, there are fewer time constraints with the possibility of flexible working hours.

source: استفاده از اینترنت و شبکه گسترده جهانی وب به یاد گیرندگان امکان دسترسی به اطلاعات را در هر زمانی میدهد.
english_gold: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.
english_hypothesis: The use of the Internet and the vast global web network provides learners with access to information at any time.

source: محصلین همچنین می توانند سوالات خود را در هر زمان از روز به معلمین ارسال کنند و پاسخ هایی نسبتاً سریع را انتظار داشته باشند، تا اینکه منتظر ملاقات حضوری بعدی باشند.
english_gold: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.
english_hypothesis: Students can also send their questions to teachers at any time of the day and expect relatively quick responses, rather than waiting for the next in-person meeting.

source: علامت "قوس بالا" مانند V و " قوس پایین" مانند یک گیره کاغذ یا مربعی است که سمت پایین آن نیست.
english_gold: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
english_hypothesis: The "upward curve" mark is like the letter "V" and the "downward curve" mark is like a paper clip or a square with the bottom side facing upwards.

source: بالا یعنی باید از نوک شروع کنید و قوس را فشار دهید و پایین یعنی از قسمت بقه (که دست شما کمان را گرفته است) شروع کنید و قوس را کش کنید.
english_gold: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
english_hypothesis: To play the violin, you must start from the tip and press the bow, and to play the cello, you start from the scroll (where your hand holds the bow) and draw the bow.

source: قوس بالا معمولا صدای ملایم تری تولید می کند، در حالیکه که قوس پایین قوی تر و مصمم تر است.
english_gold: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
english_hypothesis: The upper bow typically produces a softer sound, while the lower bow is stronger and more determined.

source: به راحتی می توانید علامت های خود را نشانی کنید، اما به یاد داشته باشید که علامات تعظیم چاپ شده به دلیل موسیقی وجود دارد، بنابراین معمولا باید به آنها احترام گذاشت.
english_gold: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
english_hypothesis: You can easily identify your signs, but remember that the signs of respect are printed due to the music, so usually you should respect them.

source: بودیزم تبتی مبتنی بر آموزه های بودا است، اما توسط مسیر عشق ماهایانا و با تکنیک های زیادی از یوگای هندی گسترش یافت.
english_gold: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
english_hypothesis: Buddhism is based on the teachings of the Buddha, but it was expanded by the Mahayana path of love and many techniques from Indian yoga.

source: در اصل بودیزم تبتی بسیار ساده است. این شامل کوندالینی یوگا، مدیتیشن و مسیر عشق همه جانبه است.
english_gold: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
english_hypothesis: Buddhism in Tibet is very simple. It includes Kundalini Yoga, meditation, and the path of all-encompassing love.

source: با کوندالینی یوگا، انرژی کوندالینی (انرژی روشنگری) از طریق وضعیت های یوگا، تمرینات تنفسی، مانتراها و تجسم ها بیدار می شود.
english_gold: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
english_hypothesis: With Kundalini Yoga, the Kundalini energy (energy of illumination) awakens through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras, and meditations.

source: مرکز مدیتیشن تبتی یوگای خدایی است. از طریق تجسم خدایان مختلف، کانال های انرژی پاک میشوند، چاکراها فعال میشوند و آگاهی روشنگری ایجاد می شوند.
english_gold: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
english_hypothesis: The Tibetan meditation center is a place of divine yoga. Through the visualization of various deities, the energy channels are purified, the chakras are activated, and awareness is illuminated.

source: جریان ترافیک مطالعه حرکت دریوران و وسایل نقلیه بین دو نقطه و تعاملات آنها با یکدیگر است.
english_gold: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
english_hypothesis: The study of traffic flow is the examination of the movement of pedestrians and vehicles between two points and their interactions with each other.

source: خوشبختانه، دریورها تمایل به رفتار در محدوده ای نسبتاً ثابت دارند؛ بنابراین، جریان های ترافیکی معمولاً تمایل به داشتن ثبات منطقی می باشند و می توانند به صورت ریاضی تقریبی به نمایش گذاشته شوند.
english_gold: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
english_hypothesis: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a relatively stable range; therefore, traffic flows usually tend to have logical stability and can be mathematically approximated.

source: برای نشان دادن بهتر جریان ترافیک، روابط بین سه ویژگی اصلی آن ایجاد شده است: (1) جریان، (2) تراکم، و (3) سرعت.
english_gold: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
english_hypothesis: To better illustrate the flow of traffic, relationships between the three main features have been created: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) speed.

source: این روابط به پلان گذاری، دیزاین و عملکرد تاسیسات جاده ها کمک می نمایند.
english_gold: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
english_hypothesis: This relationship helps in planning, designing, and performance of road facilities.

source: اگرچه هوش مصنوعی دارای مفهوم علمی تخیلی قوی می باشد، اما هوش مصنوعی شاخه بسیار مهمی از کمپیوترساینس را تشکیل می دهد، که با رفتار، یادگیری و سازگاری هوشمند در ماشین سر و کار دارد.
english_gold: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.
english_hypothesis: Although artificial intelligence has a strong concept of science fiction, artificial intelligence forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with intelligent behavior, learning, and adaptation in machines.

source: تحقیقات در ضمینه هوش مصنوعی شامل ساخت ماشین هایی برای اتومات سازی کارهایی است که نیاز به رفتار هوشمندانه دارند.
english_gold: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.
english_hypothesis: Research in the field of artificial intelligence involves creating machines that can automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.

source: مثال ها شامل کنترول، پلان گذاری و تقسیم اوقات، توانایی پاسخگویی تشخیص ها و سوالات مشتری و همچنین تشخیص دست خط، صدا و چهره می گردند.
english_gold: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.
english_hypothesis: Examples include control, planning, and time division, the ability to respond to customer inquiries and diagnoses, as well as handwriting, voice, and face recognition.

source: این چیزها به رشته های علمی جداگانه ای تبدیل شده اند که بر ارائه راه حل برای مشکلات واقعی زندگی تمرکز می کنند.
english_gold: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.
english_hypothesis: These things have evolved into separate scientific disciplines that focus on providing solutions to real-life problems.

source: سیستم هوش مصنوعی در حال حاضر اغلب در زمینه های اقتصاد، طب، انجینری و نظامی به شکلی که در چندین اپلیکیشن کمپیوتر خانگی و نرم افزارهای ویدیو گیم نیز ساخته شده است به کار برده می شود.
english_gold: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.
english_hypothesis: Artificial intelligence is currently widely used in fields such as economics, medicine, engineering, and the military, and has also been applied in various computer applications and video game software.

source: وبلاگ ها همچنین می‌توانند به بهبود نوشتن محصل کمک نمایند. در حالی که محصلین اغلب تجربه وبلاگ خود را با گرامر و املای نادرست شروع می کنند، حضور مخاطب به طور کلی آن را تغییر می دهد.
english_gold: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
english_hypothesis: Students can also benefit from blogging in terms of improving their writing skills. While students often start their blogging experience with grammatical and spelling errors, the presence of an audience generally prompts them to correct these mistakes.

source: از آنجا که محصلین اغلب از جمله منتقدترین مخاطبان هستند، نویسنده وبلاگ برای اجتناب از انتقاد تلاش می کند تا نوشتن خود را بهبود ببخشد.
english_gold: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
english_hypothesis: Students are often among the most critical audience members, so the blogger tries to improve their writing to avoid criticism.

source: همچنین وبلاگ نویسی "محصلین را مجبور می کند تا درباره دنیای اطرافشان آگاهی بیشتری کسب کنند." نیاز به تامین علاقه مخاطب به محصلین الهام می بخشد تا باهوش و با مزه باشند (توتو ، 2004).
english_gold: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
english_hypothesis:
This sentence translates to:
"Moreover, blogging inspires readers to be more aware of their surroundings and to be intelligent and discerning."

source: وبلاگ نویسی ابزاری است که همکاری را الهام می بخشد و محصلین را تشویق می کند تا یادگیری را فراتر از رویه عادی مکتب ادامه بدهند.
english_gold: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
english_hypothesis: Writing a blog is a tool that inspires collaboration and encourages students to continue learning beyond the usual routine of school.

source: استفاده مناسب از وبلاگ ها "می تواند محصلین را در تحلیلگرتر و منتقدتر کند؛ از طریق ارائه فعالانه جوابات به مطالب اینترنتی، محصلین می توانند موقعیت خود را در زمینه نوشته های دیگران تعریف کنند و دیدگاه های خود را در مورد موضوعات خاص بیان کنند (Oravec, 2002).
english_gold: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
english_hypothesis: Proper use of blogs "can make students more analytical and critical; through actively providing responses to online content, students can define their position in relation to the writings of others and express their views on specific topics (Oravec, 2002)."

source: رکاب ها تکیه گاه هایی برای پای اسب سوار هستند که در دو طرف زین آویزان شده اند.
english_gold: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
english_hypothesis: The saddlebags are supports for the horseback rider, hung on both sides of the saddle.

source: آنها ثبات بیشتری را برای اسب سوار فراهم می کنند اما به دلیل احتمال گیر افتادن پای فرد در آنها می توانند موجب بروز نگرانی های ایمنی شوند.
english_gold: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
english_hypothesis: They provide more stability for the horse rider, but due to the possibility of the rider's foot getting caught in them, they can pose safety concerns.

source: اول ، اکثر اسب سواران موزه های مخصوص اسب سواری با پاشنه و کفی صاف و کاملاً باریک می پوشند.
english_gold: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
english_hypothesis: First, most horse riders wear museum-quality riding boots with a smooth and very narrow sole.

source: بعد از آن، برخی از زین ها، به ویژه زین های انگلیسی، دارای میله های ایمنی هستند که اجازه می دهد چرم رکاب در صورت کشیده شدن به عقب توسط زین از روی زین بیفتد.
english_gold: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
english_hypothesis: After that, some saddles, especially English saddles, have safety stirrups that allow the leather girth to come off the saddle if it is pulled back by the saddle.

source: ترکیه بیشتر از 1600 کیلومتر (1000 مایل) طول و 800 کیلومتر (500مایل) عرض قلمرو با شکل تقریباً مستطیلی است.
english_gold: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.
english_hypothesis: Turkey is a country with a territory of approximately 1600 kilometers (1000 miles) in length and 800 kilometers (500 miles) in width, having a shape almost like a rectangle.

source: مساحت ترکیه، دربرگیرنده دریاچه ها، 783.562 کیلومتر مربع (300.948 مایل مربع) را اشغال میکند که 755.688 کیلومتر مربع (291.773 مایل مربع) آن در جنوب غرب آسیا و 23.764 کیلومتر مربع (9174 مایل مربع) آن در اروپا واقع است.
english_gold: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.
english_hypothesis: The area of Turkey, including lakes, covers 783,562 square kilometers (300,948 square miles), of which 755,688 square kilometers (291,773 square miles) are in Southwestern Asia and 23,764 square kilometers (9,174 square miles) are in Europe.

source: ترکیه‌ی اروپایی (تراس شرقی یا رومیلیا در شبه جزیره ای بالکان) دربرگیرنده ای 3 فیصد از کشور میشود.
english_gold: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.
english_hypothesis: Turkey in Europe (Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan Peninsula) comprises about 3% of the country.

source: مساحت ترکیه، ترکیه را به 37مین کشور بزرگ دنیا تبدیل کرده است و تقریباً به اندازه ای مساحت مجموعی شهرهای بزرگ فرانسه و انگلستان است.
english_gold: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.
english_hypothesis: Turkey's area has made it the 37th largest country in the world and its area is almost equal to the combined area of the large cities of France and England.

source: ترکیه از سه جهت توسط دریاها احاطه شده است: دریای اژه درغرب، دریای سیاه در شمال و دریای مدیترانه در جنوب.
english_gold: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.
english_hypothesis: Turkey is surrounded by the sea from three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north, and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

source: جزایر کوک کشوری جزیره ای در معاشرت آزاد با نیوزلند، واقع در پلینزی، وسط اقیانوس آرام جنوبی است.
english_gold: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.
english_hypothesis: The Cook Islands are a group of islands in free association with New Zealand, located in the South Pacific Ocean.

source: این مجمع الجزایر با 15 جزیره در 2/2 میلیون کیلومتر مربع از اقیانوس گسترده شده است.
english_gold: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.
english_hypothesis: This archipelago, comprising 15 islands, spans 2.2 million square kilometers of ocean.

source: این جزایر با منطقه زمانی مشابه هاوایی، گاهی اوقات به عنوان "هاوایی پایین" تصور می شوند.
english_gold: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".
english_hypothesis: These islands are sometimes referred to as "Lower Hawaii" due to their similar time zone to the state of Hawaii.

source: جزایر کوک هیچ شهری ندارند اما از 15 جزیره مختلف تشکیل شده اند. اصلی ترین آنها راروتونگا (Rarotonga) و آیتوتاکی (Aitutaki) می باشد.
english_gold: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.
english_hypothesis: The Cook Islands have no cities, but are composed of 15 different islands, with Rarotonga and Aitutaki being the largest.

source: رودخانه آمازون دومین رودخانه طولانی و بزرگترین رودخانه روی زمین است. این دریا 8 برابر بیشتر نسبت به دومین رودخانه بزرگ دنیا آب حمل می کند.
english_gold: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
english_hypothesis: The Amazon River is the second-longest and largest river on Earth. It carries 8 times more water than the second-largest river in the world.

source: همچنان، آمازون عریض ترین رودخانه روی زمین است که در برخی مواقع شش مایل عرض دارد.
english_gold: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
english_hypothesis: Amazon River is the widest river on Earth, reaching up to six miles in width at certain times.

source: 20 فیصد آبی که از رودخانه های کره زمین به اقیانوس ها می ریزد از آمازون می آید.
english_gold: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
english_hypothesis: 20% of the blue that flows from the rivers of the Earth to the oceans comes from the Amazon.

source: رودخانه اصلی آمازون 6،387 کیلومتر (3،980 مایل) است. رودخانه آمازون آب هزاران رود کوچکتر را جمع می کند.
english_gold: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
english_hypothesis: The Amazon River, the main river, is 6,387 kilometers (3,980 miles) long. The Amazon River collects the waters of thousands of smaller rivers.

source: جزیره هانگ کانگ نام خود را به قلمرو هانگ کانگ داده و جایی است که بسیاری از گردشگران آن را تمرکز اصلی در نظر می گیرند.
english_gold: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
english_hypothesis: Hong Kong Island is named after the territory of Hong Kong, and it is a place where many tourists consider it their main focus.

source: قسمت بزرگی از انکشاف شهری جزیره هانگ کانگ به صورت متراکم در زمین های احیا شده در امتداد ساحل شمالی قرار دارد.
english_gold: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
english_hypothesis: A significant portion of Hong Kong's urban development is concentrated in reclaimed land along the northern coast.

source: جلوه ساختمان هایی که خط افق هنگ کنگ را می سازد به بار چارتی درخشان تشبیه شده می شود که با حضور آبهای بندر ویکتوریا ظاهر می گردد.
english_gold: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
english_hypothesis: The skyline of the buildings that form the Hong Kong horizon is likened to a radiant cargo ship that appears with the presence of Victoria Harbour waters.

source: برای دیدن بهترین مناظر هانگ کانگ، جزیره را ترک کرده به سمت ساحل کولون در سمت مخالف بروید.
english_gold: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
english_hypothesis: To see the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head towards the Kowloon coast on the opposite side.

source: ساندربان ها بزرگترین کمربند درختان ساحلی حرا در جهان می باشد که به طول 80 کیلومتر (50 مایل) به مناطق داخلی بنگلادیش و هند امتداد یافته است.
english_gold: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
english_hypothesis: The Sundarbans is the largest mangrove forest in the world, spanning 80 kilometers (50 miles) and extending into the interior of Bangladesh and India.

source: ساندربان ها به حیث ساحه میراث جهانی یونسکو اعلام شده است. قسمتی از جنگل در قلمرو هند، پارک ملی ساندربانس نامیده می شود.
english_gold: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
english_hypothesis: The Sundarbans have been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. A part of the forest in the Indian territory is called the Sundarbans National Park.

source: با این حال جنگل ها تنها باتلاقهای حرا نیستند - آنها شامل برخی از آخرین بقایای جنگل های بزرگ هستند که زمانی دشت گنگتیک را پوشانیده بودند.
english_gold: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
english_hypothesis: The forests are not just the mangrove swamps - they also include some of the last remnants of the vast forests that once covered the Gondwana plains.

source: ساندربان ها مساحتی در حدود 3850 کیلومتر مربع را پوشانیده اند که تقریباً یک سوم حصه آن را مناطق آبی/باتلاقی پوشانیده است.
english_gold: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
english_hypothesis: Sandbanks cover an area of approximately 3,850 square kilometers, with about one-third of this area being aquatic or wetland.

source: از سال 1966، ساندربان ها پناهگاه حیات وحش بوده اند و تخمین زده می شود که در حال حاضر 400 ببر رویال بنگال و حدود 30،000 گوزن خالدار در منطقه موجود می باشد.
english_gold: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
english_hypothesis: Since 1966, Sundarbans has been a sanctuary for wildlife. It is estimated that there are currently 400 Royal Bengal tigers and approximately 30,000 spotted deer in the area.

source: سانسکریت یک زبان قدیمی و با زبان لاتینی که در اروپا صحبت می شود قابل مقایسه است.
english_gold: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.
english_hypothesis: Sanskrit is an ancient language similar to Latin, which is spoken in Europe.

source: در مورد چگونگی پیدایش سانسکریت تیوری های زیادی وجود دارد. یکی از آنها درمورد مهاجرت آریایی به هند از غرب است که زبان خود را با خود آورده بودند.
english_gold: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.
english_hypothesis: There are many theories about the origin of Sanskrit. One of them is about the migration of the Aryans from the west to India, bringing their language with them.

source: اولین کتاب شناخته شده در جهان به زبان سانسکریت نوشته شده است. پس از تکمیل اوپانیشادها، سانسکریت بنابر تغییر سلسله ها از بین رفت.
english_gold: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.
english_hypothesis: The first known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the completion of the Upanishads, Sanskrit disappeared due to the change of dynasties.

source: سانسکریت یک زبان خیلی پیچیده و کاملی است که بعنوان منبع خادم خیلی زبان های جدید هندی بوده است، دقیقاٌ همانند زبان لاتین که منبع زبان های اروپایی مانند فرانسوی و اسپانیایی است.
english_gold: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.
english_hypothesis: Sanskrit is a very complex and complete language that has been a source of many new Indian languages, just like Latin is the source of European languages such as French and Spanish.

source: در قرن 15-پانزدهم، استونیای شمالی تحت تاثیر فرهنگی شدیدی آلمانی قرار داشت.
english_gold: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.
english_hypothesis: In the 15th century, Northern Estonia was heavily influenced by German culture.

source: بعضی از صومعه نشینان آلمانی میخواستند خدا را به مردم بومی نزدیک بسازند، بناً زبان ساده ای استونیایی را ابداع کردند.
english_gold: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.
english_hypothesis: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the local people, so they invented a simple Estonian language.

source: طبق الفبای آلمانی بود و یک کرکتر "Õ/õ" اضافه شد.
english_gold: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.
english_hypothesis: This text was written in the German alphabet and an additional character "Õ/õ" was added.

source: با گذشت زمان، بسیاری از کلمات که از زبان آلمانی قرض گرفته شده بود با هم مدغم شدند. این شروع روشنگری بود.
english_gold: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.
english_hypothesis: With the passage of time, many words borrowed from the German language merged together. This was the beginning of illumination.

source: سیکیزم دینی از شبه قاره هند است. در طول قرن 15هم در منطقه پنجاب از یک انشعاب فرقه ای از مراسم هندو سرچشمه گرفت.
english_gold: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.
english_hypothesis: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian subcontinent. In the 15th century, in the region of Punjab, it branched off from a sectarian movement of Hindu rituals.

source: سیک ها ایمان خود را دینی جدا از هندویسم می دانند، اگرچه ریشه ها و رسم و رواج های هندوی آن را تصدیق می کنند.
english_gold: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.
english_hypothesis: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism, although they acknowledge its roots and practices are rooted in Hinduism.

source: سیک ها دین خود را گورمات می نامند که در پنجابی به معنای "راه گورو" است. گورو جنبه اساسی همه ادیان هندی است، اما در آیین سیک اهمیتی پیدا کرده است که هسته اعتقادات سیک را تشکیل می دهد.
english_gold: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.
english_hypothesis: Sikhs call their religion "Gurmat" which in Punjabi means "the path of the Guru". The Guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions, but in Sikhism, it has gained importance and forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

source: این دین در قرن 15هم توسط گورو ناناک (1539-1469) پایه گذاری شد. به دنبال آن (نه) گورو ای دیگر وجود داشت.
english_gold: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.
english_hypothesis: This religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469-1539).

source: محیط نظامی امپراتوری روم به توسعه پیشرفت های پزشکی کمک کرد.
english_gold: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.
english_hypothesis: The military environment of the Roman Empire contributed to the development of medical advancements.

source: داکتران توسط امپراتور اگستوس استخدام شدند و حتی اولین سپاه طبی رومی را برای استفاده در عواقب نبردها تشکیل دادند.
english_gold: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.
english_hypothesis: The doctors were employed by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman medical corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

source: جراحان از داروهای آرام بخش مختلف از جمله مورفین از عصاره دانه های خشخاش و اسکوپولامین از دانه های هربان آگاهی داشتند.
english_gold: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.
english_hypothesis: The wounded were aware of various sedatives, including morphine from opium poppy seeds and scopolamine from henbane seeds.

source: آنها در قطع عضو برای نجات مریضان از قانقاریا و همچنین استفاده از تورنیکت و گیره شریانی برای جلوگیری از جریان خود مهارت پیدا کردند.
english_gold: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.
english_hypothesis: They have learned to amputate limbs to save patients from gangrene, as well as to use tourniquets and artery clamps to prevent bleeding.

source: در طی چندین قرن،امپراتوری روم به دستاوردهای عظیمی در زمینه طبابت منجر شد و بسیاری از دانشی را که امروز می شناسیم، تشکیل داد.
english_gold: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.
english_hypothesis: The Roman Empire, over the course of several centuries, achieved tremendous advancements in the field of medicine and laid the foundation for much of the knowledge we recognize today.

source: برای مدتی طولانی در طول قرن نوزدهم و بیستم، باور بر این بود که اولین ساکنان نیوزلند مردم مائوری بودند که پرندگان عظیم الجثه بنام مواس را شکار می نمودند.
english_gold: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.
english_hypothesis: For a long time during the 19th and 20th centuries, it was believed that the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Māori people who hunted the large flightless birds known as Moa.

source: سپس این تئوری این نظریه را شکل داد که مردم مائوری با تعداد زیادی کشتی از پولینیشیا مهاجرت کردند و نیوزلند را از موریوری گرفتند و جامعه ای زراعت کار را بنیاد نهادند.
english_gold: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.
english_hypothesis: Then this theory took shape that the Maori people migrated to New Zealand with a large number of ships from Polynesia and founded an agricultural society.

source: با این حال، شواهد جدید حاکی از آن است که موریوری گروهی از سرزمین اصلی مائوری بودند که از نیوزلند به جزایر چاتهام مهاجرت کرده و فرهنگ متمایز و مسالمت آمیز خود را توسعه دادند.
english_gold: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.
english_hypothesis: However, new evidence suggests that the Māori were a group of people from the mainland who migrated to the Chatham Islands from New Zealand and developed their own distinct and peaceful culture.

source: قبیله دیگری نیز در جزایر چاتهام وجود داشت، اینها مائوری ها بودند که از نیوزلند مهاجرت کرده بودند.
english_gold: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.
english_hypothesis: There was another tribe in the Chatham Islands, these were the Maori who had migrated from New Zealand.

source: آنها خود را موریوری نامیدند، چندین کشمکش بین آنها رخ داد و در نهایت، موریوری از بین رفت.
english_gold: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out
english_hypothesis: They called themselves Mauyuri, several conflicts arose among them, and eventually, Mauyuri ceased to exist.

source: مدنیت یک فرهنگ جداگانه است که بین گروه بزرگی از مردم که در یک جامعه زندگی و کار میکنند مشترک است.
english_gold: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
english_hypothesis: Civilization is a distinct culture shared among a large group of people living and working together in a society.

source: کلمه civilization از civil لاتین که در لاتین civis به معنی شهروند و civitas به معنای شهر یا شهر-دولت می آید و این نیز گرچه اندازه جامعه را مشخص می کند.
english_gold: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
english_hypothesis: The word "civilization" comes from the Latin "civil," meaning "citizen," and "civitas," meaning "city" or "city-state."

source: دولت شهرها اجداد ملت ها هستند. یک فرهنگ مدنی مستلزم انتقال دانش از چندین نسل است، نشانه های فرهنگی جاودان و پخش عادلانه.
english_gold: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
english_hypothesis: The government of cities are the ancestors of nations. A civil culture requires the transmission of knowledge across multiple generations, eternal cultural signs and fair distribution.

source: فرهنگ های کوچک اغلب بدون به جا گذاشتن آثار تاریخی مرتبط ناپدید می شوند و به عنوان تمدن های خاص شناخته نمی شوند.
english_gold: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
english_hypothesis: Cultures of small nations often disappear without leaving behind historical legacies and are not recognized as civilizations.

source: خطوط واگن در اوایل قرن شانزدهم در انگلستان ساخته شدند.
english_gold: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
english_hypothesis: Railway tracks were built in England in the early sixteenth century.

source: گرچه خطوط واگن فقط از تخته چوب های موازی تشکیل شده بودند، اما به اسب هایی که آن ها را می کشیدند امکان می داد به سرعت بیشتری رسیده و بارهای بیشتری را نسبت به جاده های ناهموار آن زمان بکشند.
english_gold: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
english_hypothesis: Although the wagon's rails were made of only parallel wooden planks, they allowed the horses to pull faster and heavier loads than the rough roads of that time.

source: این به عملی معمول تبدیل شد، اما آهن سبب ساییدگی بیشتر چرخ های چوبی واگن گردید.
english_gold: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
english_hypothesis: This became a common practice, but iron caused more wear on the wooden wagon wheels.

source: سرانجام چرخ های چوبی با چرخ های آهنی جایگزین شدند. در سال 1767، اولین خطوط ریل کاملاً فولادی معرفی شدند.
english_gold: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
english_hypothesis: The wooden wheels were eventually replaced by iron ones. In 1767, the first fully iron rail lines were introduced.

source: گوارانی ها مهمترین گروه بومی ساکن پاراگوئه شرقی امروزی بودند و به عنوان شکارچیان نیمه کوچی زندگی می کردند که برای معیشت زراعت نیز انجام می دادند.
english_gold: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
english_hypothesis: The Guarani people were the most important indigenous group inhabiting modern-day eastern Paraguay and lived as semi-nomadic hunters who also practiced subsistence farming.

source: منطقه چاکو محل اقامت گروه های دیگری از قبایل بومی مانند گایاکوری و پایاگوآ بود که با شکار، جمع کردن و ماهیگیری دوام آوردند.
english_gold: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
english_hypothesis: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes, such as the Guaicuru and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering, and fishing.

source: در قرن 16، پاراگوئه که قبلاً "ولایت عظیم بومیان" نامیده می شد، در نتیجه تقابل فاتحان اسپانیایی با گروه های بومی به وجود آمد.
english_gold: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
english_hypothesis: In the 16th century, Paraguay, previously known as "Vilayet-i-azim-i-bumiyan" (the "Great Vilayet of the Natives"), came into existence as a result of the confrontation between Spanish conquerors and the indigenous groups.

source: اسپانیایی ها دوره استعماری را آغاز کردند که سه قرن به طول انجامید.
english_gold: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
english_hypothesis: The Spanish began a period of colonization that lasted for three centuries.

source: هرگونه اردو زدن پایینتر از لبه گردند کانیون نیازمند به کسب مجوز می باشد.
english_gold: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.
english_hypothesis: Any camping below the edge of the canyon requires a permit.

source: مجوزها برای محافظت از دره محدود است و در اولین روز ماه، چهار ماه قبل از ماه اول، در دسترس قرار می گیرد.
english_gold: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.
english_hypothesis: Permits are limited for protecting the valley and are available on the first day of the month, four months before the first month.

source: بنابراین، مجوز رفتن به این مناطق برای هر یک از تاریخهای ماه می، از یکم ماه جنوری آغاز صادر می گردد.
english_gold: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.
english_hypothesis: Therefore, the permit for traveling to these areas will be issued starting from the first day of May, for each of the dates in May.

source: فضای محبوب ترین مناطق، مانند اردوگاه Bright Angel در مجاورت Phantom Ranch، به طور کلی با درخواست های دریافت شده در اولین تاریخ که برای رزرو باز می شود، پر می گردد.
english_gold: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.
english_hypothesis: The most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground near Phantom Ranch, fill up quickly with the requests received on the first day it opens for reservations.

source: این شهر دقیقاً در کنار آبشارها قرار دارد و آنها جاذبه اصلی آن هستند، اما این مقصد گردشگری محبوب برای اقامت طولانی مدت فرصت های زیادی را برای ماجراجویان و منظره گردان ارائه می دهد.
english_gold: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.
english_hypothesis: This city is situated exactly next to waterfalls and they are its main attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers many opportunities for adventurers and nature lovers to stay for a long time.

source: در فصل بارانی (نوامبر تا مارچ)، حجم آب بالاتر و آبشار مهیج تر خواهد بود.
english_gold: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.
english_hypothesis: In the rainy season (November to March), the volume of water will be higher and the waterfalls will be more thrilling.

source: اگر از روی پل عبور کنید یا در امتداد مسیرهایی که در نزدیکی آبشارها پیچیده اند قدم بزنید، خیس می شوید.
english_gold: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.
english_hypothesis: If you cross the bridge or walk along paths that wind near waterfalls, you will get wet.

source: از طرف دیگر، دقیقاً به این دلیل است که حجم آب آنقدر زیاد است که مشاهده شما از آبشارهای واقعی - با وجود آن همه آب - مبهم می شود!
english_gold: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!
english_hypothesis: The reason is that the volume of water is so great that your view of the actual waterfalls - with all that water - becomes hazy!

source: این کوه شیب دار در منتهی الیه شمالی ماچوپیچو قد کشیده است، که اغلب پس زمینه بسیاری عکس ها از ویرانه ها می باشد.
english_gold: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.
english_hypothesis: This mountain, with its steep slope, is located at the northernmost point of Machu Picchu, and often serves as the backdrop for many photos of the ruins.

source: از پایین کمی دلهره آور به نظر می رسد و صعودی شیب دار و دشوار است، اما بیشتر افراد دارای تناسب اندام نسبی می توانند در حدود 45 دقیقه این مسیر را طی کنند.
english_gold: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.
english_hypothesis: The path appears to be a bit daunting from below, with a steep and challenging incline. However, most people with average fitness can complete this route in about 45 minutes.

source: زینه های سنگی در امتداد قسمت بیشتر مسیر قرار داده شده است و در قسمت های شیبدارتر کیبل های فولادی دستگیره ای حمایوی فراهم می کنند.
english_gold: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.
english_hypothesis: The stone barriers are placed along most of the route, and cable handrails made of iron are provided in the steeper sections.

source: با این اوصاف، انتظار کم نفس شدن را داشته باشید و در قسمت های شیبدار، بخصوص هنگام تر بودن مراقب باشید، زیرا می تواند به سرعت خطرناک شود.
english_gold: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.
english_hypothesis: Be prepared for a thrilling ride and be extra cautious in the steep sections, especially when wet, as it can become treacherous in no time.

source: یک مغاره کوچک در نزدیکی قسمت بالایی وجود دارد که باید از آن عبور کرد، این مغاره بسیار کم ارتفاع و تنگ است.
english_gold: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.
english_hypothesis: There is a small gorge near the upper part that must be crossed, and this gorge is very low and narrow.

source: پیاده روی فعالیتی در فضای باز است که شامل پیاده روی در محیط های طبیعی، اغلب در مسیرهای پیاده روی می شود.
english_gold: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.
english_hypothesis: Hiking is an outdoor activity that involves walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

source: پیاده روی روزانه شامل مسافتهای کمتر از یک مایل تا مسافتهای طولانی تر است که می توان در یک روز طی کرد.
english_gold: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.
english_hypothesis: The daily walk includes distances of less than a mile to longer distances that can be covered in a day.

source: برای پیاده روی یک روزه در مسیری آسان به آمادگی های کمی نیاز است و هر فردی با تناسب اندام متوسط می تواند از آن لذت ببرد.
english_gold: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.
english_hypothesis: For a one-day hike on an easy route, little preparation is needed, and anyone with average fitness can enjoy it.

source: فامیل هایی که اطفال کوچک دارند ممکن به آمادگی بیشتری نیاز داشته باشند، اما یک روز بیرون از خانه حتی با نوزادان و اطفال مهد کودک به راحتی امکان پذیر است.
english_gold: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.
english_hypothesis: Families with young children may require more preparation, but a day out of the house, even with infants and toddlers, is easily achievable.

source: گرچه بسیاری از حیوانات موجود در پارک به دیدن انسان عادت دارند، با این وجود حیوانات وحشی هستند و نباید به آنها غذا داده شود یا مزاحمتی برای آنها ایجاد گردد.
english_gold: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
english_hypothesis: Although many animals in the park are accustomed to seeing humans, they are still wild animals and should not be fed or disturbed.

source: به گفته مقامات پارک، باید حداقل 100 یارد/متر از خرس و گرگ و 25 یارد/متر از دیگر حیوانات وحشی فاصله داشته باشید!
english_gold: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
english_hypothesis: You must be at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters away from other wild animals.

source: مهم نیست که چقدر مطیع به نظر برسند، گاومیش، گوزن، گوزن شمالی، خرس و تقریباً همه حیوانات بزرگ می توانند حمله ور شوند.
english_gold: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
english_hypothesis: It doesn't matter how obedient they seem, a gaur, a deer, a reindeer, a bear, and almost all large animals can attack.

source: سالانه ده ها نفر از بازدیدکنندگان به دلیل عدم رعایت فاصله مناسب مجروح می شوند. این حیوانات، بزرگ، وحشی و بالقوه خطرناک هستند، بنابراین فضای لازم را به آنها بدهید.
english_gold: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
english_hypothesis: Every year, dozens of visitors are injured due to not maintaining a safe distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them the space they need.

source: علاوه بر این، توجه داشته باشید که بوها، خرس ها و سایر حیوانات وحشی را به خود جذب می کنند، بنابراین از حمل یا پخت غذاهای معطر خودداری کرده و چادری پاکیزه داشته باشید.
english_gold: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
english_hypothesis: In addition, be aware that scents, bears, and other wild animals are attracted to them, so refrain from carrying or cooking fragrant foods and keep a clean tent.

source: هرکسی که قصد دارد در ارتفاعات بالا یا بر فراز کوه ها دریوری کند، باید احتمال بارش برف، یخ یا یخبندان را در نظر بگیرد.
english_gold: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
english_hypothesis: Anyone planning to sail in high altitudes or over mountains should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or icing.

source: در جاده های یخی و برفی، اصطکاک کم است و نمی توانید مانند آسفالت لخت دریوری کنید.
english_gold: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
english_hypothesis: On icy and snowy roads, friction is low, and you cannot drive like on a smooth asphalt road.

source: در هنگام کولاک، ممکن در زمانی کوتاه برف کافی برای گیر افتادن شما ببارد.
english_gold: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
english_hypothesis: When a blizzard hits, it's possible that a significant amount of snow will fall within a short period, causing you to get stuck.

source: ممکن ساحه دید نیز با افتادن یا وزیدن برف یا با تراکم یا یخ روی شیشه های موتر محدود شود.
english_gold: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
english_hypothesis: The field of view may also be limited by falling or drifting snow or by the accumulation or freezing of ice on the windshield.

source: از سوی دیگر، شرایط یخی و برفی در بسیاری از کشورها عادی است و ترافیک عمدتاً بدون وقفه در تمام طول سال ادامه دارد.
english_gold: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
english_hypothesis: In contrast, icy and snowy conditions are common in many countries and traffic generally continues without interruption throughout the year.

source: گردش های اکتشافی ها شاید بزرگترین جاذبه گردشگری در آفریقا و نقطه عطف برای بسیاری از بازدیدکنندگان باشد.
english_gold: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
english_hypothesis: Exploratory tours may be the largest tourist attraction in Africa and a turning point for many visitors.

source: اصطلاح گردش اکتشافی در استفاده عمومی به سفرهای زمینی برای مشاهده حیات وحش خیره کننده آفریقا، به ویژه در ساوانا اشاره دارد.
english_gold: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
english_hypothesis: The term "safari" in common usage refers to land-based travel in Africa, particularly in the savanna, for the purpose of observing wildlife.

source: برخی از حیوانات، مانند فیل ها و زرافه ها، تمایل دارند به موتر ها نزدیک شوند و تجهیزات استندرد امکان مشاهده خوب را فراهم می کند.
english_gold: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
english_hypothesis: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach motor vehicles and the standard equipment provides a good view.

source: شیرها، یوزپلنگ ها و پلنگ ها گاهی خجالتی هستند و با دوربین دو چشمی آنها را بهتر خواهید دید.
english_gold: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
english_hypothesis: Lions, leopards, and tigers are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.

source: یک گردشگری تفریحی پیاده (همچنین "پیاده روی در بوته" ، "سافاری پیاده روی" یا "پیاده روی" نامیده می شود) شامل پیاده روی چند ساعته یا چند روزه است.
english_gold: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
english_hypothesis: A leisurely hike (also known as "bushwalking," "safari on foot," or simply "hiking") involves walking for several hours or days.

source: بیگ گردی با اسکی: همچنین این فعالیت اسکی در مناطق دورافتاده، تور اسکی یا پیاده روی اسکی نیز گفته می شود.
english_gold: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
english_hypothesis: Backcountry skiing: This activity is also known as ski touring or ski hiking in remote areas.

source: این امر مربوط به تور اسکی یا کوهنوردی به سبک آلپ است اما معمولاً شامل این موارد نمی شود، دومی که در زمین های شیبدار انجام می شود و نیاز به اسکی و موزه های بسیار سخت تری دارد.
english_gold: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
english_hypothesis: This refers to alpine skiing or mountaineering, but usually does not include the second type, which is done on sloping terrain and requires much harder skis and equipment.

source: به مسیر اسکی به عنوان یک مسیر پیاده روی مشابه بیاندیشید.
english_gold: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
english_hypothesis: Think of the ski trail as a similar hiking trail.

source: در شرایط خوب می توانید مسافت های بیشتری را به نسبت پیاده روی طی کنید - اما به ندرت می توانید سرعت اسکی روی سطح را بدون بیگ پشتی سنگین در مسیرهای آماده به دست آورید.
english_gold: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
english_hypothesis: In good conditions, you can cover more distance on foot than by skiing on a surface without a heavy backpack.

source: پالیسی بیمه را کاپی کنید و کاپی بیمه نامه و معلومات تماس شرکت بیمه خود را همراه خود داشته باشید.
english_gold: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.
english_hypothesis: Please copy your insurance policy, copy your insurance card, and bring your insurance card and contact information for your insurance company with you.

source: آنها برای مشاوره/مجوزها و ایراد دعوی باید آدرس ایمیل شرکت بیمه و شماره تلیفون های بین المللی را نشان دهند.
english_gold: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.
english_hypothesis: They must provide the email address of the insurance company and international phone numbers for consultation/permits and to file a claim.

source: کاپی دیگری در بکس خود و به صورت آنلاین داشته باشید (با پیوست به خودتان ایمیل کنید، یا ذخیره در "کلود").
english_gold: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").
english_hypothesis: Have a copy of it in your box and also online (attach it to your email or save it in "Cloud").

source: اگر با لپ تاپ یا تبلت سفر می کنید، یک نسخه را در مموری یا دیسک آن ذخیره کنید (قابل دسترس بدون اینترنت).
english_gold: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).
english_hypothesis: If you are traveling with a laptop or tablet, save a copy on the memory or disk (available offline).

source: همچنین کاپی پالیسی/تماس را به همراهان سفر و اقوام یا دوستان مایل به کمک در مبدا بدهید.
english_gold: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.
english_hypothesis: Also, provide the copy of the policy/contract to the travel companions and tribes or friends who are willing to assist at the source.

source: در هنگام بار بردن برای دیگران - هرگز بیگ های خود را از جلوی چشمتان دور نکنید، به ویژه هنگامی که از مرزهای بین المللی عبور می نمایید.
english_gold: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.
english_hypothesis: When lifting for others - never remove your eyes from your bags, especially when crossing international borders.

source: شما می توانید بدون اطلاع خود به عنوان حامل مواد مخدر مورد استفاده قرار بگیرید، که دردسرهای فراوانی برای شما ایجاد خواهد کرد.
english_gold: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.
english_hypothesis: You can be used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will cause you a lot of trouble.

source: این روند شامل انتظار در صف است، زیرا سگ های مواد یاب در هر زمانی ممکن بدون اطلاع قبلی استفاده شود.
english_gold: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.
english_hypothesis: This process involves waiting in line, as the dogs of the material search team can be used at any time without prior notice.

source: بیگ های بدون صاحب هدف سرقت هستند و همچنین می توانند توجه مقامات را در مورد تهدید بمبگذاری جلب کنند.
english_gold: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.
