english_hypothesis: Big bags without an owner are thefts and can also attract the attention of the authorities regarding the threat of bombing.

source: صبح شکم خود را با یک قهوه غنی و شب با یک چای آرام بخش بابونه پر کنید.
english_gold: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.
english_hypothesis: Start your day with a rich coffee and end it with a calming chamomile tea.

source: هنگام اقامت، فرصت دارید به خودتان برسید و چند دقیقه ای اضافه وقت بگذارید تا چیز خاصی را دم کنید.
english_gold: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.
english_hypothesis: When staying, you have the opportunity to come to yourself and spend a few extra minutes to freshen up.

source: اگر احساس می کنید ماجراجو هستید، از فرصت استفاده کرده و برخی تسکین دهنده ها را خورده یا مخلوط کنید:
english_gold: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:
english_hypothesis: If you feel adventurous, take advantage of the opportunity and try some of the following:

source: شاید یک نوشیدنی ساده پیدا کنید که می توانید برای صبحانه پس از بازگشت به برنامه روزانه خود، آن را تهیه نمایید.
english_gold: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.
english_hypothesis: You may find a simple drink that you can prepare for breakfast after returning to your daily routine.

source: خانم ها: توصیه می شود که تمام مسافران خانم بدون در نظر گرفتن وضعیت تأهل واقعیشان، خود را متاهل بگویند.
english_gold: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
english_hypothesis: Ladies: It is recommended that all female travelers, regardless of their marital status, consider themselves married.

source: استفاده از انگشتر نیز مفید است (نه انگشتری که خیلی قیمتی به نظر برسد.)
english_gold: It is helpful to also wear a ring (just not one that looks too expensive.
english_hypothesis: Using a ring is also beneficial (not a ring that seems too expensive.)

source: زنان میبایست درک کنند تفاوت های فرهنگی ممکن منجر به چیزی که آنها آزار و اذیت می دانند گردد و تعقیب شدن یا از بازو گرفته شدن و غیرمعمول نمی باشد.
english_gold: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
english_hypothesis: Women should understand that cultural differences may lead to what they consider harassment, and being chased or grabbed is not normal.

source: در پس زدن مردان قاطع باشید و از ایستادگی بر موقف خود نترسید (تفاوت های فرهنگی یا غیره، درستش نمیکند!).
english_gold: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
english_hypothesis: Be resolute like men and stand firm in your position, undaunted by cultural differences or any other obstacles.

source: اکوادور مقرر کرده است که شهروندان کوبایی باید قبل از ورود به اکوادور از طریق فرودگاه‌های بین‌المللی یا نقاط پذیرش مرزی دعوت نامه دریافت کنند.
english_gold: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.
english_hypothesis: Ecuador has decreed that Cuban citizens must obtain an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or border entry points.

source: این نامه باید توسط وزارت امور خارجه اکوادور به رسمیت شناخته شده و با الزاماتی خاص مطابقت کند.
english_gold: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.
english_hypothesis: This letter must be recognized by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ecuador and comply with specific requirements.

source: این الزامات برای ایجاد جریان مهاجرت سازمان‌ یافته بین دو کشور طراحی شده‌اند.
english_gold: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.
english_hypothesis: These requirements are designed to create an organized migration flow between the two countries.

source: شهروندان کوبایی که دارنده کارت سبز آمریکا می باشند میبایست برای کسب معافیت از این الزامات به کنسولگری اکوادور مراجعه نمایند.
english_gold: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.
english_hypothesis: Cuban citizens who hold a Green Card in the United States must visit the Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption from these requirements.

source: پاسپورت شما باید حداقل 6 ماه بعد از تاریخ سفرتان اعتبار داشته باشد. برای اثبات طول مدت اقامتتان به تکت رفت و برگشت نیاز دارید.
english_gold: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.
english_hypothesis: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after your travel date. You need a return ticket to prove the duration of your stay.

source: اگر می خواهید دنیا را از نظر ضرورت، شیوه زندگی یا چالش به صورت ارزان بگردید، راه هایی برای این کار وجود دارد.
english_gold: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.
english_hypothesis: If you want to travel the world on a shoestring budget, there are ways to do so.

source: اساساً، آنها به دو دسته تقسیم می شوند: یا هنگام مسافرت کار کنید یا سعی کنید هزینه های خود را محدود کنید. این مقاله بر مورد دوم تمرکز دارد.
english_gold: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.
english_hypothesis: In essence, they are divided into two categories: either work while traveling or try to limit your expenses. This article focuses on the latter.

source: برای کسانی که مایلند آسایش، زمان و قابلیت پیش بینی را قربانی کنند تا هزینه ها را به صفر برسانند، سفر با حداقل بودجه را ملاحظه کنید.
english_gold: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.
english_hypothesis: For those who are willing to sacrifice comfort, time, and predictability to reach zero costs, consider budget travel.

source: این توصیه فرض می کند که مسافران سرقت نمی کنند، تخطی نمی کنند، در بازار غیرقانونی شرکت نمی کنند، گدایی نمی کنند و یا از دیگران در جهت منافع خود سوء استفاده نمی کنند.
english_gold: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.
english_hypothesis: This recommendation assumes that travelers do not steal, do not cheat, do not engage in illegal activities in the market, do not beg, and do not exploit others for their own benefit.

source: در حالی که به حیث بازدید کننده یا به هدف تجارت شما برای سفرهای کوتاه به کشورهای مختلف نیاز به ویزه نداشته باشید، مسافرت به آنجا به حیث محصل معمولاً به نسبت توریستی عادی نیاز به اقامت طولانی تر دارد.
english_gold: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.
english_hypothesis: As a visitor or for business purposes, you may not need a visa for short trips to various countries. However, as a student, you usually require a longer stay, similar to that of a tourist.

source: به طور معمول، اقامت طولانی مدت در هر کشور خارجی نیازمند دریافت ویزه پیش از وقت توسط شما می باشد.
english_gold: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.
english_hypothesis: Generally, a long-term stay in any foreign country requires obtaining a visa in advance by you.

source: در کل شرایط و طرزالعمل هایی درخواست ویزه تحصیلی با ویزه سیاحتی یا تجاری متفاوت است.
english_gold: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.
english_hypothesis: The requirements and procedures for a student visa are different from those for a tourist or business visa.

source: برای اکثر کشورها، شما نامه معرفی نهادی که می خواهید در آن تحصیل نمایید، و همچنان حداقل شواهد استطاعت مالی مورد نیاز سال اول دوره تحصیلی خود را ضرورت خواهید داشت.
english_gold: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.
english_hypothesis: For most countries, you will need to provide a letter of introduction from the institution you wish to attend, as well as proof of financial ability to cover your first year of studies.

source: برای معلومات دقیق با موسسه تحصیلی و نیز اداره مهاجرت کشور مربوطه که می خواهید در آن تحصیل نمایید ارتباط برقرار کنید.
english_gold: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.
english_hypothesis: To obtain precise information, contact the educational institution and the immigration office of the country you wish to study in.

source: اروپا قاره ای نسبتاً کوچک اما دارای کشورهایی مستقل زیاد است. در شرایط عادی، سفر از طریق چندین کشور به معنی چندین بار طی مراحل درخواست های ویزه و کنترول پاسپورت می باشد.
english_gold: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
english_hypothesis: Europe is a relatively small continent with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, traveling through multiple countries means going through multiple visa application and passport control procedures.

source: اما منطقه شینگن از این نظر تا حدودی مانند یک کشور واحد عمل می کند.
english_gold: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
english_hypothesis: The Schengen Area functions to a certain extent like a single country in this regard.

source: به طور کلی تا زمان اقامت در این منطقه، می توانید بدون عبور دوباره از چک پاینت های پاسپورت از مرزها گذر کنید.
english_gold: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
english_hypothesis: You can pass through the borders without re-checking the passport checkpoints during your stay in this area.

source: به طور مشابه، با داشتن ویزه شینگن، نیازی به درخواست ویزه به صورت جداگانه برای هر یک از کشورهای عضو شینگن ندارید، بنابراین در وقت، پول و کاغذپرانی صرفه جویی می کنید.
english_gold: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
english_hypothesis: With a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for a separate visa for each Schengen country, thus saving time, money, and paperwork.

source: مسافرینی که به آسانی با فرهنگ جدید سازگاری پیدا می کنند، در برخی از موارد در سازگاری مجدد با فرهنگ محلی خود با مشکلاتی مواجه می شوند.
english_gold: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
english_hypothesis: Travelers who easily adapt to the new culture may encounter difficulties in readjusting to their local culture.

source: زمانی که پس از زندگی در خارج به وطن خود باز می گردید، شما با یک فرهنگ جدید سازگار شده و برخی از عادات فرهنگ اصلی تان را از دست داده اید.
english_gold: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
english_hypothesis: When you return to your homeland after living abroad, you have adapted to a new culture and lost some of the customs of your original culture.

source: بار اول که به خارج رفتید، مردم احتمالاً با صبر و شکیبایی شمار را درک می کردند؛ زیرا آنان می دانستند که مسافرین در یک کشور جدید، باید خود را با شرایط آن کشور سازگار بسازند.
english_gold: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
english_hypothesis: The first time you went out, people probably understood your number with patience and tolerance; because they knew that travelers in a new country must adapt to the conditions of that country.

source: ممکن هست مردم تصور نکنند که صبر و تحمل و درک شرایط نيز برای مسافرینی که به خانه هایشان باز می گردند لازم است.
english_gold: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
english_hypothesis: It is possible that people may not think that patience, tolerance, and understanding the situation are also necessary for travelers who are returning to their homes.

source: روش واضح پرواز در درجه اول یا تجاری این است که برای این امتیاز مقدار زیادی پول جمع آوری کنید (یا بهتر است از شرکت خود بخواهید تا این کار را برایتان انجام دهد.)
english_gold: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
english_hypothesis: The clear method of flying first class or business class is to gather a large amount of money for this privilege (or better yet, ask your company to do it for you).

source: با این حال، چنین پروازهایی ارزان نمی باشند: به عنوان یک قاعده کلی، هزینه پرواز تجاری میتواند چهار برابر پرواز اقتصادی و هزینه پرواز درجه یک میتواند یازده برابر آن باشد!
english_gold: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
english_hypothesis: However, such flights are not cheap: as a general rule, the cost of a business flight can be four times that of an economic flight, and the cost of a first-class flight can be eleven times that of an economic flight!

source: به طور کلی، حتی در پروازهای مستقیم از یک مبدا به مقصد مشخص، هیچ نوع تخفیف برای صندلی های تجاری یا درجه یک وجود ندارد.
english_gold: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
english_hypothesis: There is no discount for business or first-class seats, even on direct flights from one specific origin to destination.

source: شرکت های هوایی خوب می دانند که یک گروه خاص از متقاضیان پرواز وجود دارند که مایلند برای برخورداری از یک سفر سریع و راحت، مصارف بسیار زیاد پرداخت نمایند.
english_gold: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
english_hypothesis: Airline companies know that there is a specific group of passengers who are willing to pay a lot for a fast and comfortable journey.

source: این مظاهره حوالی ساعت 11:00 به وقت محلی (UTC+1) در مقابل وایت هال دخولی گارد پولیس در جاده داوننگ، محل اقامت رسمی نخست وزیرآغاز گردید.
english_gold: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.
english_hypothesis: This protest began around 11:00 a.m. local time (UTC+1) in front of Whitehall, near the official residence of the Prime Minister, Downing Street.

source: فقط بعد از ساعت 11:00، مظاهره کننده گان ترافیک را در قسمت شمال وایت هال مسدود کرده بود.
english_gold: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.
english_hypothesis: Protesters had blocked traffic in the north part of Whitehall after 11:00.

source: ساعت 11:20، پولیس از مظاهره کننده گان خواست تا بطرف پیاده رو حرکت کنند و اظهار کردن که آنها نیاز داشتند که حق مظاهره کردن را با افزایش ترافیک متوازن سازند.
english_gold: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.
english_hypothesis: At 11:20 a.m., the police asked the protesters to move towards the sidewalk and stated that they needed to balance the right to protest with the increasing traffic.

source: حوالی ساعت 11:29، مظاهره بطرف وایت هال رفت، پیشتر از چهارایی ترافالگر، در امتداد سترند، که از الدویچ تیر شد و از کینگزوی بطرف هولبرن حرکت کرد جاییکه حزب محافظه کار اجتماع بهاری خود را در هوتل گریند کونات رومز برگزار می کرد.
english_gold: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.
english_hypothesis: Around 11:29, the protest march moved towards Whitehall, ahead of the Conservative Party's Spring Conference at the Grindlays Hotel, which had taken place in Holborn.

source: قوای صلح سازمان ملل متحد که بعد از زلزله ۲۰۱۰ هیتی به آنجا رسیدند بخاطر گسترش مرض متهم شدند، این مرض در نزدیکی قرارگاه این قوا منتشر شد.
english_gold: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
english_hypothesis: The United Nations peacekeeping forces that arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake were accused of spreading the disease, which broke out near their camp.

source: بر اساس دعوای حقوقی، فاضلات از کمپ سازمان ملل بدرستی پاک سازی نشده بودند، بخاطر آنکه باکتریا از طریق یکی از مخرج های دریای آرتیبونیت که یکی از دریاهای بزرگ هیتی است، داخل شده بودند.
english_gold: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
english_hypothesis: The sewage from the UN camp had not been properly cleaned due to a legal dispute, and bacteria had entered through one of the outlets of the Artibonite Sea, one of the largest seas in Haiti.

source: قبل از رسیدن قوا، هیتی از سال های ۱۸۰۰ بدینسو، با اینچنین مشکلات مربوط به مرض روبرو نشده بود.
english_gold: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
english_hypothesis: Before the arrival of the forces, Haiti had not faced such problems related to the disease since the year 1800.

source: انستیتوت هیتی برای عدالت و دموکراسی از چندین تحقیقات مستقل استفاده کرده است و میگوید که قوای نیپالی سازمان ملل این مرض را به هیتی با خود آوردند.
english_gold: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
english_hypothesis: The Institute for Human Rights and Democracy in Afghanistan has used multiple independent researches and claims that the Nepalese forces brought this disease to Hiti.

source: دانیاله لانتاگه، یک متخصص سازمان ملل در مورد این مرض، میگوید که شیوع به احتمال قوی توسط قوای صلح سبب گردید.
english_gold: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
english_hypothesis: Daniele Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, says the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeeping forces.

source: پادشاه وحشت زده لویی شانزدهم، ملکه ماری آنتوانت، دو فرزند خردسالشان (ماری ترز 11 ساله و لویی – چارلز چهارساله) و خواهر پادشاه، خانم الیزابت، در 6 اکتوبر 1789 توسط انبوه از مردم از بازار زنان به پاریس بازگردانده شدند.
english_gold: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
english_hypothesis: King Louis XVI, terrified, Queen Marie Antoinette, their two young children (Marie-Therese, 11 years old, and Louis-Charles, 4 years old), and the king's sister, Madame Elizabeth, were returned to Paris from the market of women on October 6, 1789, by a multitude of people.

source: آنها در یک گادی به پاریس بازگشتند و در محاصره انبوهی از مردم که فریاد می زدند و علیه پادشاه و ملکه تهدید می کردند.
english_gold: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
english_hypothesis: They returned to Paris in a carriage and found themselves surrounded by a multitude of people who were shouting and threatening the king and queen.

source: انبوه مردم پادشاه و ملکه را مجبور کردند که پنجره های گادی خود را کاملا باز کنند.
english_gold: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
english_hypothesis: A large crowd forced the king and queen to open their car windows completely.

source: به یکبارگی یکی از اعضای اوباش سر یک گارد سلطنتی را که در ورسای کشته شده بود در مقابل ملکه ای وحشت زده تکان داد.
english_gold: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
english_hypothesis: One of the rioters shook the body of a royal guard who had been killed in Versailles in front of a terrified queen.

source: این برنامه پی بی اس، بیشتر از دو درجن جایزه ایمی دارد و مدت فعالیت ها فقط از کوچه سیسامی و قریه آقای روجرز کمتر بوده است.
english_gold: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.
english_hypothesis: This PBS program has more than two decades of awards and its duration is only slightly less than Sesame Street and Mr. Rogers' Neighborhood.

source: هر قسمت ازین برنامه یک موضوع خاص از یک کتاب را بر میداشت و از طریق چندین داستان به آن می پرداخت.
english_gold: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.
english_hypothesis: This program covered various topics from a book, each episode focusing on a specific subject and exploring it through multiple stories.

source: هر برنامه همچنان سفارشاتی برای کتاب ها ارائه می کرد و به اطفال می گفت برای دریافت آن به کتابخانه بروند.
english_gold: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.
english_hypothesis: The program continued to offer orders for books and told children to go to the library to receive them.

source: جون گرانت، از مرکز بوفالو گفت «خوانش کمان رستمی به اطفال یاد داد چرا باید کتاب بخوانند، و آنها را تشویق کرد تا کتاب ها را بردارند و مطالعه کنند».
english_gold: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."
english_hypothesis: John Grant, from the Buffalo Center, said, "Rostami's reading to children taught them why they should read books, and encouraged them to take books and study."

source: این باور بعضی هاست بشمول جون گرانت که تغییر در فلسفه برنامه ریزی تلویزیون تعلیمی باعث اتمام این مجموعه گردید.
english_gold: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.
english_hypothesis: This belief, including those who value their lives, is that the change in the educational programming philosophy of television led to the conclusion of this series.

source: او در وقت اش در اتلانتا تحسین حیاتی را دریافت کرد و برای تعلیم شهری خلاقانه شناخته شده بود.
english_gold: She gained critical acclaim during her time in Atlanta and was recognized for innovative urban education.
english_hypothesis: He received crucial acclaim in Atlanta at the time and was known for his innovative urban teaching.

source: در 2009 برای او عنوان ناظر ملی سال اعطا گردید.
english_gold: In 2009 she was awarded the title of National Superintendent of the Year.
english_hypothesis: In 2009, he was awarded the title of National Observer of the Year.

source: در زمان اهدای این، مکاتب اتلانتا شاهد بهبود بزرگ در نتایج آزمایش بوده است.
english_gold: At the time of the award, Atlanta schools had seen a large improvement on test scores.
english_hypothesis: During the time of this donation, the Atlanta schools have witnessed a significant improvement in test results.

source: شواهد بعد از آن نشان داد که اوراق امتحان با هال و 34 مقام دیگر آموزش دستکاری شده بود، این معلومات در 2013 مشخص شد.
english_gold: Evidence thereafter indicated test papers were tampered with Hall, along with 34 other education officials, was indicted in 2013.
english_hypothesis: The evidence that followed showed that the test papers had been tampered with by Hall and 34 others, which was revealed in 2013.

source: جودوکا هیتوشی سایتو جاپانی، برنده دو مدال طلاء المپیک، در سن 54 سالگی وفات کرد.
english_gold: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.
english_hypothesis: Hitoshi Saito, a Japanese judoka and two-time Olympic gold medalist, passed away at the age of 54.

source: او در اوساکا روز سه شنبه فوت کرد.
english_gold: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.
english_hypothesis: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

source: علت مرگ سرطان داخل مجرا صفرا اعلان شد.
english_gold: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

source: این بازی به روی چمن انجام می شود و زمین چمن اطراف سوراخ ها کوتاهتر بوده و سبزه نامیده می شود.
english_gold: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.
english_hypothesis: This game is played on grass, and the grass around the holes is shorter and is called "sabzeh".

source: همه چیز در جهان از ماده ساخته شده است. تمام مواد از ذرات کوچکی به نام اتم تشکیل شده اند.
english_gold: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
english_hypothesis: Everything in the world is made of matter. All matter is composed of tiny particles called atoms.

source: اتم ها آنقدر کوچک هستند که تریلیون ها عدد آن در نقطه پایانی این جمله جای می شوند.
english_gold: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
english_hypothesis: Atoms are so small that trillions of them can fit at the end of this sentence.

source: اتم می تواند یکی از اجزای اساسی تمام مواد در نظر گرفته شود.
english_gold: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.
english_hypothesis: Atoms can be considered one of the fundamental components of all matter.

source: هویتی بسیار پیچیده است که براساس یک مادل ساده شده بور، از هسته ای مرکزی که الکترون ها به دور آن می چرخند تشکیل شده است، که تا حدودی شبیه سیارات در حال گردش به دور خورشید است - شکل 1.1 را ببینید.
english_gold: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.
english_hypothesis: The atom is a very complex entity that is based on a simplified model of Bohr, consisting of a central nucleus around which electrons revolve, somewhat similar to the planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

source: هسته از دو ذره تشکیل شده است - نیوترون و پروتون.
english_gold: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.
english_hypothesis: The nucleus is composed of two particles: the neutron and the proton.

source: پروتون ها داری بار الکتریکی مثبت هستند در حالی که نیوترون ها بدون بار هستند. الکترون ها بار الکتریکی منفی دارند.
english_gold: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.
english_hypothesis: Protons have a positive electric charge, while neutrons have no charge. Electrons have a negative electric charge.

source: حجره کوچکترین واحد ساختمانی و وظیفوی یک جاندار (چیز) است.
english_gold: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.
english_hypothesis: Cell is the smallest unit of structure and function of an organism.

source: حجره از واژه لاتین cella به معنی اتاق کوچک گرفته شده است.
english_gold: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.
english_hypothesis: The word "hujra" is derived from the Latin word "cella," meaning a small room.

source: اگر یک موجود زنده را در زیر میکروسکوپ نگاه بیاندازید، مشاهده خواهید کرد که آنها از مربع ها یا دایره های کوچک ساخته شده اند.
english_gold: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.
english_hypothesis: If you look at a living being under a microscope, you will see that they are made up of small squares or circles.

source: آنها شبیه اطاق بودند. او اولین شخصی بود که حجرات مرده را مشاهده کرد.
english_gold: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells
english_hypothesis: They were like a room. He was the first person to see the dead chambers.

source: زمان چیزی است که در اطراف ما می باشد و بر همه کارهایی که انجام میدهیم تاثیر می گذارد، اما هنوز هم درک آن دشوار است.
english_gold: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.
english_hypothesis: Time is something that surrounds us and affects all the things we do, but still understanding it is difficult.

source: ما زمان را بشکل مجموعه ای از رخدادهای آینده که از زمان حال به گذشته می گذرند، تجربه می کنیم.
english_gold: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.
english_hypothesis: We experience time as a collection of future events that pass from the present into the past.

source: همچنین، زمان، چگونگی مقایسه مدت (طول) رخدادها می باشد.
english_gold: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.
english_hypothesis: Time, how events are compared in terms of duration, is also a factor.

source: شما می توانید گذر زمان را با مشاهده تکرار یک رویداد دورانی مشخص کنید. یک رویداد دورانی چیزی است که بارها و بارها به طور منظم اتفاق می افتد.
english_gold: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.
english_hypothesis: You can determine the passage of time by observing the repetition of a periodic event. A periodic event is something that happens regularly and repeatedly.

source: در حال حاضر MySpace در ایالت متحده سومین ویب سایت مشهور است و 54 میلیون استفاده کننده دارد.
english_gold: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.
english_hypothesis: MySpace is currently the third most popular website in the United States, with 54 million users.

source: این وبسایت ها توجه زیاد بخود جلب کرده است، مخصوصاً در عرصه تحصیلات.
english_gold: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.
english_hypothesis: These websites have attracted a lot of attention, especially in the field of education.

source: این ویب سایت ها دارای جنبه های مثبت می باشند مانند: آسانی در تنظیم یک صفحه صنفی که شامل بلاگ ها، ویدیوها، عکس ها، و دیگر خصوصیات میگردد.
english_gold: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.
english_hypothesis: This website has positive aspects such as ease of setting up a professional page that includes blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

source: این صفحه به اسانی با فراهم سازی فقط یک آدرس انترنتی در دسترس است، که هم برای بحافظه سپردن و هم تایپ کردن برای شاگردان که در قسمت استفاده کیبورد یا املا مشکل دارند آسان ساخته شده است.
english_gold: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.
english_hypothesis: This page is easily accessible with just one online address, which is designed to be easy for students who have difficulty with keyboard usage or spelling to remember and type.

source: میشود آنرا بطور فرمایشی ساخت که خواندنش آسان و با هر قدر کم یا بیش رنگ مطابق میل باشد.
english_gold: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.
english_hypothesis: It should be made in a way that it is easy to read and the color can be adjusted according to one's preference, whether more or less.

source: اپلیکیشن های ترجمه متن لحظه ای - اپلیکیشن هایی که قابلیت ترجمه خودکار بخش هایی از متن یک زبان به زبان دیگر را دارند.
english_gold: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.
english_hypothesis: Real-time text translation applications - applications that have the capability to automatically translate parts of text from one language to another.

source: برخی از اپلیکیشن هایی که شامل این کتگوری می شوند حتی می توانند نوشته های زبان های خارجی که روی علائم یا اشیاء دیگر در دنیای واقعی نوشته شده اند، در زمانی که کاربر تلفون هوشمند را به سمت آن اشیاء نشان می گیرد ترجمه کنند.
english_gold: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.
english_hypothesis: Some applications in this category can even translate written texts in foreign languages that are written on signs or objects in the real world, as long as the user points their smartphone at them.

source: ماشین های ترجمه به طور چشمگیری بهبود یافته اند، و در حال حاضر اغلب ترجمه هایی نسبتاً صحیح (و به ندرت بی مفهوم) انجام می دهند، اما نیاز به توجه دارند، زیرا ممکن تمام متن را اشتباه ترجمه کرده باشند.
english_gold: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.
english_hypothesis: Machine translations have significantly improved, and they now often produce relatively accurate (and rarely nonsensical) translations. However, they still require attention, as they may still translate the entire text incorrectly.

source: یکی از عالی ترین اپلیکیشن ها در این کتگوری گوگل ترانسلیت است که پس از دانلود داده زبان مورد نظر امکان ترجمه آفلاین را فراهم می کند.
english_gold: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.
english_hypothesis: Google Translate is one of the best applications in this category, which after downloading, provides the ability to translate offline in the desired language.

source: زبان های رسمی بارسلونا کاتالان و اسپانیایی می باشد. تقریباً نصف شهر به زبان کاتالان صحبت می کند، اکثریت مطلق این زبان را می فهمند، و در واقع تمام نفوس این شهر زبان آسپانیایی را می دانند.
english_gold: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
english_hypothesis: The official languages of Barcelona are Catalan and Spanish. Almost half of the city's population speaks Catalan, the majority understand it perfectly, and in fact, all the inhabitants of this city know Spanish.

source: به هر حال، اکثر علائم فقط به زبان کاتالان نشان داده می شود، زیرا طبق قانون کاتالان به عنوان اولین زبان رسمی تعیین شده است.
english_gold: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
english_hypothesis: In any case, most signs are only shown in Catalan, as Catalan is established as the first official language according to the Catalan law.

source: با این وجود، اسپانیایی همچنان به شکل گسترده در ترانسپورت عمومی و سایر امکانات استفاده می شود.
english_gold: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
english_hypothesis: Despite this, Spanish is still widely used in public transportation and other facilities.

source: آگهی های معمول در مترو فقط به زبان کاتالان نوشته می شوند، اما اختلالات پلان نشده به وسیله سیستمی خودکار به زبان های مختلف از جمله اسپانیایی، انگلیسی، فرانسوی، عربی و جاپانی اعلام می شود.
english_gold: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
english_hypothesis: Advertisements in the metro are usually in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced in multiple languages, including Spanish, English, French, Arabic, and Japanese, through an automated system.

source: آژانس های مسافرتی از قرن نوزدهم وجود داشته اند. آژانس مسافرتی معمولاً گزینه مناسبی برای سفری است که فراتر از تجربه قبلی مسافر از طبیعت، فرهنگ، زبان یا کشورهای کم درآمد می باشد.
english_gold: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.
english_hypothesis: Travel agencies have existed since the 19th century. Travel agencies are usually a good option for a trip that goes beyond the traveler's previous experience in nature, culture, language, or low-income countries.

source: اگرچند اغلب آژانس ها مایل به رزروهای معمولی هستند، اما بسیاری از نمایندگان در نوع خاصی از سفرها، محدوده بودجه یا مقاصد تخصص دارند.
english_gold: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.
english_hypothesis: While many agencies prefer standard bookings, many representatives specialize in specific types of travel, budget ranges, or destinations.

source: بهتر است از آژانسی استفاده کنید که اغلب سفرهای مشابه مورد شما را رزرو می کند.
english_gold: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.
english_hypothesis: It is better to use an agency that often books similar trips to yours.

source: به سفرهای تبلیغی آژانس، در ویب سایت و در ویترین دکان نگاهی بیندازید.
english_gold: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.
english_hypothesis: Take a look at the agency's promotional trips on the website and in the store window.

source: رزرو پیش از وقت به مسافر آرامش ذهنی می دهد که پس از رسیدن به مقصد، جایی برای خواب خواهد داشت.
english_gold: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
english_hypothesis: Booking in advance gives the traveler mental peace of mind, knowing that upon arrival at their destination, they will have a place to sleep.

source: آژانس های مسافرتی اغلب با هوتل های خاصی تعامل می کنند، اگرچه ممکن است از طریق آژانسی مسافرتی امکان رزرو سایر اقامتگاه ها مانند محل کمپینگ را پیدا کنید.
english_gold: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
english_hypothesis: Travel agencies often interact with specific hotels, although you may be able to find options for other types of accommodations, such as camping sites, through a travel agency.

source: آژانس های مسافرتی معمولاً بسته هایی را ارائه میدهند که شامل صبحانه، ترتیبات ترانسپورت به/از میدان هوایی یا حتی پروازهای ترکیبی و بسته های هوتل می گردد.
english_gold: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
english_hypothesis: Travel agencies usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation to/from the airport, or even combined flights and hotel packages.

source: در صورت نیاز به زمان برای فکر کردن در مورد پیشنهاد یا تهیه اسناد دیگر برای مقصد (به عنوان مثال روادید)، آنها می توانند برای شما رزرویشن را نگاه کنند.
english_gold: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
english_hypothesis: They can hold your reservation if you need time to think about the proposal or prepare additional documents for the destination (such as a visa).

source: هرگونه اصلاحات یا درخواست باید در ابتدا از طریق آژانس مسافرتی و نه مستقیماً با هوتل انجام شود.
english_gold: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
english_hypothesis: All changes or requests must be made through the travel agency first, not directly with the hotel.

source: قوانین معمول عکاسی برای فیلمبرداری یا حتی ممکن موارد دیگر نیز تطبیق می گردد.
english_gold: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.
english_hypothesis: The usual rules of photography are also applicable to filming or even other possible cases.

source: در صورتی که عکس گرفتن از چیزی مجاز نیست، شما نباید حتی فکر فیلمبرداری از آن را داشته باشید.
english_gold: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.
english_hypothesis: If taking a photo of something is not allowed, you should not even think about filming it.

source: اگر از پهباد و یا طیارهء بدون سرنشین استفاده می کنید، پیش از وقت خوب بررسی کنید از چه چیزهای می توانید فیلم بگیرید و چه جوازها یا تصدیق های اضافی ضرورت می باشد.
english_gold: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.
english_hypothesis: If you are using a drone or an unmanned aircraft, please check beforehand what you can film and what additional permits or approvals are required.

source: استفاده از درون نزدیک به میدان هوایی یا بالای جمعیت، حتی اگر این کار در ساحه شما غیرقانونی نباشد، تقریباً همیشه یک ایده نامناسب است.
english_gold: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.
english_hypothesis: Using a drone near an airport or over a crowd, even if it's legal in your area, is almost always a bad idea.

source: برخلاف دیگر اولیه ها ، انسان ها دیگر از دستان خود برای حرکت یا تحمل وزن یا چرخش در میان درختان استفاده نمی کنند.
english_gold: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.
english_hypothesis: Humans no longer use their hands for movement, support of weight, or rotation among trees, unlike other primates.

source: دست و پای شامپانزه از نظر اندازه و طول مشابه است که نشان دهنده استفاده دست برای تحمل وزن در راه رفتن با بند انگشت است.
english_gold: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.
english_hypothesis: The hand and foot of a chimpanzee are similar in size and length, indicating that the hand is used to support the weight while walking on the fingers.

source: دست انسان کوتاهتر از پا است و استخوان های صاف تری دارد.
english_gold: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.
english_hypothesis: The human hand is shorter than the foot and has smoother bones.

source: استخوان های فسیلی دست دو میلیون تا سه میلیون ساله نشان دهنده این تغییر در تخصص دست از حرکت به دستکاری است.
english_gold: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.
english_hypothesis: The fossilized bones of hands dating back two to three million years indicate a shift in hand specialization from movement to manipulation.

source: MRI براساس پدیده ای فیزیکی به نام رزونانس مغناطیسی هسته ای (NMR) می باشد که در دهه 1930 توسط فلیکس بلوخ (استاد دانشگاه استنفورد) و ادوارد پورسل (از دانشگاه هاروارد) کشف شد.
english_gold: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).
english_hypothesis: MRI is based on a physical phenomenon known as nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR).

source: در این رزونانس، میدان مغناطیسی و امواج رادیویی باعث می شوند اتم ها سیگنال های رادیویی کوچکی را منتشر کنند.
english_gold: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.
english_hypothesis: In this resonance, the magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to emit small radio signals.

source: در سال 1970، ریموند دامادیان ، داکتر طب معالجوی و دانشمندی محقق، مبنای استفاده از تصویربرداری توسط رزونانس مغناطیسی را به حیث وسیله ای برای معاینات طبی کشف کرد.
english_gold: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.
english_hypothesis: In 1970, Raymond Damadian, a doctor of medical research and a scholar, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a means of medical examination.

source: چهار سال بعد حق ثبت اختراع آن صادر شد، که اولین اختراع ثبت‌ شده جهان در زمینه MRI بود.
english_gold: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.
english_hypothesis: Four years later, the patent was granted, which was the first patent ever issued for MRI technology.

source: داکتر دامادیان ساخت اولین اسکنر MRI "کل بدن" را که "تسخیر ناپذیر" نامید را در سال 1977 به پایان رساند.
english_gold: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.
english_hypothesis: Dr. Damadian completed the first whole-body MRI scanner, which he called "unhackable," in 1977.

source: برای کسانی که با اصطلاحات طبی آشنا نیستند، واژه های عفونی و واگیر دارای معانی متمایزی هستند.
english_gold: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.
english_hypothesis: For those who are not familiar with medical terminology, the words "infectious" and "contagious" have distinct meanings.

source: یک مریضی عفونی به وسیله عاملی بیماریزا مانند ویروس، باکتری، قارچ یا سایر انگل ها ایجاد می شود.
english_gold: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.
english_hypothesis: A contagious disease is caused by an infectious agent such as a virus, bacterium, fungus, or other parasites.

source: مرض ساری مرضی است که با قرار گرفتن در مجاورت فرد آلوده به راحتی منتقل می شود.
english_gold: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.
english_hypothesis: This is a disease that is easily transmitted by proximity to an infected person.

english_hypothesis: The large glass panes and thin walls of it were unable to withstand the attack for a long time.

source: اورشلیم پایتخت و بزرگترین شهر اسرائیل است، هرچند اکثر کشورها و سازمان ملل متحد آن را به عنوان پایتخت اسرائیل نمی شناسند.
english_gold: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.
english_hypothesis: Tel Aviv is the capital and largest city of Israel, although most countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as the capital of Israel.

source: شهر قدیمی در تپه های یهودا دارای تاریخ هزاران ساله ای جذاب می باشد.
english_gold: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.
english_hypothesis: The ancient city on the hills of Judea has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

source: این شهر برای سه دین توحیدی - یهودیت، مسیحیت و اسلام مقدس است و به حیث یک مرکز معنوی، مذهبی و فرهنگی عمل می کند.
english_gold: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.
english_hypothesis: This city is sacred for the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity, and Islam - and serves as a center for spiritual, religious, and cultural activities.

source: اورشلیم به دلیل اهمیت مذهبی این شهر، و به ویژه مکانهای متعدد منطقه شهر قدیم، یکی از مقاصد اصلی توریستی در اسرائیل میباشد.
english_gold: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.
english_hypothesis: Jerusalem is a major tourist destination in Israel due to its religious significance and the numerous historical sites within the Old City.

source: اورشلیم دارای تعداد زیادی مکان های تاریخی، باستانی و فرهنگی، همراه با مراکز خرید، کافه ها و رستوران های پر ازدحام می باشد.
english_gold: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.
english_hypothesis: Jerusalem is home to a large number of historical, ancient, and cultural sites, as well as bustling shopping centers, cafes, and restaurants.

source: برخی از هوتل ها میراثی از دوران طلایی راه آهن بخار و کشتی های اقیانوس شناسی قبل از جنگ جهانی دوم در قرن 19 یا اوایل قرن 20 دارند.
english_gold: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.
english_hypothesis: Some hotels have a legacy from the golden age of steam locomotives and oceanographic ships before World War II in the 19th or early 20th century.

source: این هوتل ها محل اقامت افراد ثروتمند و مشهور دوران بود و اغلب غذای خوب و زندگی شبانه داشتند.
english_gold: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.
english_hypothesis: These hotels were the place of residence for the wealthy and famous during their time and often had good food and nightlife.

source: لوازم قدیمی، نبود آخرین امکانات رفاهی و قدمت برازنده نیز بخشی از شخصیت آنهاست.
english_gold: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.
english_hypothesis: The old furniture, the lack of modern amenities, and the antiquity that suits them are all part of their character.

source: در حالی که آنها معمولاً خصوصی هستند، گاهی اوقات میزبان سران دولت ها و سایر مقامات بازدید کننده می باشند.
english_gold: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.
english_hypothesis: They are usually private, but sometimes they host heads of state and other visiting dignitaries.

source: نمایشگاه جهانی (که معمولا نمایشگاه جهانی یا به سادگی نمایشگاه نامیده می شود) یک جشنواره بین المللی بزرگ هنر و علوم است.
english_gold: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.
english_hypothesis: The World Exhibition (commonly referred to as the World's Fair or simply the Exhibition) is a grand international festival of art and science.

source: کشورهای شرکت کننده در غرفه های ملی نمایش های هنری و آموزشی ارائه می دهند تا مسائل جهان یا فرهنگ و تاریخ کشورشان را به نمایش بگذارند.
english_gold: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.
english_hypothesis: Countries participating in the national pavilions showcase artistic and educational performances to display issues of the world, their culture, or history.

source: نمایشگاه های بین المللی باغبانی رویدادهای تخصصی هستند که نمایش های گل، باغ های گیاه شناسی و هر کار دیگری که با گیاهان انجام می شود را به نمایش می گذارند.
english_gold: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.
english_hypothesis: International horticultural exhibitions are specialized events that showcase flower shows, botanical gardens, and any other activities related to plants.

source: این رویدادها معمولاً بین سه تا شش ماه به طول می انجامد و در مکان هایی کلان تر از 50 هکتار برگزار می شود.
english_gold: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
english_hypothesis: This event usually lasts between three to six months and is held in locations larger than 50 hectares.

source: بابلی ها برای هر یک از خدایان خود معبد اساسی ساختند که خانه خدا محسوب می شد.
english_gold: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
english_hypothesis: The Babylonians built a fundamental temple for each of their gods, which was considered the house of God.

source: مردم قربانی ها را به خدایان می آوردند و کشیش ها می کوشیدن از طریق مراسم و فیستیوال ها به نیازمندیهای خدایان توجه کنند.
english_gold: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
english_hypothesis: People would offer sacrifices to the gods and priests would strive to attend to the needs of the gods through rituals and festivals.

source: هر معبد یک صحن باز پرستشگاه داشت و بعد یک پناهگاه که در آن تنها کشیش میتوانیست وارد شود.
english_gold: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
english_hypothesis: Each temple had an open courtyard for worship and then a sanctuary where only the priest could enter.

source: بعضی اوقات برج های ویژه دارای شکل احرام بنام زیگوراتس منحیث یک بخش معبد ها اعمار گردیده بودند.
english_gold: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
english_hypothesis: Some times, the special towers, known as zigurats, were built as a part of temples.

source: قسمت بالایی برج پرستشگاه خاصی برای خدا بود.
english_gold: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
english_hypothesis: The upper part of the minaret was a place of worship for a specific God.

source: هرم بزرگ غزه تنها یکی از عجایب هفتگانه است که هنوز پابرجاست.
english_gold: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
english_hypothesis: The Great Pyramid of Giza is one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World that still stands today.

source: هرم بزرگ که توسط مصری ها در قرن سوم قبل از میلاد ساخته شد، یکی از تعداد بناء های هرمی بزرگ است که در احترام به فرعون از دنیا رفته ساخته شده است.
english_gold: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
english_hypothesis: The Great Pyramid of Giza, built by the ancient Egyptians in the third century BC, is one of the largest pyramid structures ever built, constructed as a tribute to the pharaoh who had passed away.

source: فلات غزه یا "نکروپلیس غزه" در دره مردگان مصر شامل چندین هرم (که هرم بزرگ بزرگترین آنهاست)، چندین مقبره کوچک، چندین معبد و ابوالهول بزرگ است.
english_gold: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
english_hypothesis: The Gaza Strip, also known as Necropolis Gaza, in the Valley of the Dead in Egypt, comprises several pyramids (with the Great Pyramid being the largest), several smaller tombs, several temples, and the Great Sphinx.

source: هرم بزرگ برای احترام به فرعون خوفو ساخته شد و بسیاری از اهرام کوچکتر، مقبره ها و معابد برای احترام به همسران و اعضای خانواده خوفو ساخته شدند.
english_gold: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
english_hypothesis: The Great Pyramid was built to honor Pharaoh Khufu, and many smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor his wives and family members.

source: جمعیت شهر واتیکان در حدود 800 نفر می باشد. واتیکان کوچکترین کشور مستقل در جهان و کشوری با کمترین جمعیت است.
english_gold: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
english_hypothesis: The population of Vatican City is approximately 800 people. Vatican City is the smallest independent country in the world and has the lowest population.

source: شهر واتیکان از زبان ایتالیایی در قوانین و ارتباطات رسمی خود استفاده می کند.
english_gold: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
english_hypothesis: The Vatican City uses Italian as its official language in its laws and official communications.

source: همچنین، زبان ایتالیایی زبان روزمره اکثر کسانی که در دولت کار می کنند می باشد، در حالی که اغلب در مراسم های مذهبی لاتین به کار برده می شود.
english_gold: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
english_hypothesis: Italian is the common language of most people working in the government, while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.

source: تمام شهروندان شهر واتیکان کاتولیک رومی هستند.
english_gold: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
english_hypothesis: All citizens of the Vatican City are Roman Catholics.

source: نمایش هرم صدا و نور یکی از جالبترین رویدادهای منطقه برای اطفال است.
english_gold: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
english_hypothesis: The display of sound and light pyramid is one of the most interesting events in the region for children.

source: می توانید اهرام را در تاریکی و سکوت پیش از شروع نمایش ببینید.
english_gold: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
english_hypothesis: You can see the pyramids in the darkness and silence before the show begins.

source: معمولاً همیشه شما صدای توریست ها و فروشندگان را می شنوید. داستان این صدا و روشنایی درست مانند یک کتاب داستان است.
english_gold: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
english_hypothesis: You usually hear the sounds of tourists and vendors. The story of this sound and light is like a storybook.

source: مجسمه ابوالهول به حیث پرده عقب و نریتور یک داستان طولانی تنظیم شده است.
english_gold: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
english_hypothesis: The Abu al-Hawl statue has been set as the backdrop and narrator of a long story.

source: صحنه ها بر روی اهرام به نمایش گذاشته شده و اهرام مختلف روشن گردیده اند.
english_gold: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
english_hypothesis: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids, and the pyramids have been illuminated.

source: لطفاً به یاد داشته باشید که شما اساساً از محل یک گور دسته جمعی و همچنان از مکانی که برای بخش قابل توجهی از جمعیت جهان معنایی تقریباً غیرقابل محاسبه دارد بازدید می کنید.
english_gold: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
english_hypothesis: Please remember that you are visiting a place that is essentially a mass grave and a location that holds almost incomprehensible meaning for a significant portion of the world's population.

source: هنوز تعداد زیادی از مردان و زنان در قید حیات در اینجا هستند که از اینجا نجات یافته اند ، و بسیاری دیگر از کسانی که عزیزانی، اعم از یهودی یا غیر یهودی، داشته که در آنجا به قتل رسیده یا تا سرحد مرگ کار کرده اند.
english_gold: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
english_hypothesis: There are still many men and women alive today who were saved from there, and many others who had loved ones, whether Jewish or non-Jewish, who were killed or worked to death there.

source: لطفاً با این مکان با نهایت عزت، افتخار و احترامی که شایسته آن است برخورد کنید. درباره هولوکاست یا نازی ها فکاهی نگویید.
english_gold: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
english_hypothesis: Please treat this place with the utmost respect, dignity, and honor it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or the Nazis.

source: با نوشتن روی دیوار یا خراشیدن نقاشی های دیواری روی تعمیرها، این مکان را از شکل نیندازید.
english_gold: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
english_hypothesis: Do not deface this place by writing on the walls or scratching off the murals.

source: رایجترین علت سوانح در زمستان، جاده ها، پیاده روها و بخصوص زینه های لغزنده است.
english_gold: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.
english_hypothesis: The most common cause of accidents in winter is the roads, sidewalks, and especially slippery slopes.

source: حداقل، شما بوت هایی با کفی مناسب ضرورت دارید. بوت های تابستانی معمولاً روی یخ و برف بسیار لغزنده هستند، حتی برخی از بوت های زمستانی کارآمد نیستند.
english_gold: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.
english_hypothesis: You need boots with good soles at the very least. Summer boots are usually very slippery on ice and snow, and even some winter boots are not effective.

source: طرح باید به اندازه کافی عمیق باشد، 5 میلی متر (1/5 اینچ) یا بیشتر، و مواد باید در هوای سرد به اندازه کافی نرم باشد.
english_gold: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.
english_hypothesis: The design should be deep enough, at least 5 millimeters (1/5 inch) or more, and the material should be soft enough in cold weather.

source: پاشنه ها باید پایین و پهن باشد. ریگ و جغل یا نمک (کلسیم کلوراید) اکثراً روی جاده ها یا مسیرها برای بهبود قوه کششی ریخته می شود.
english_gold: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.
english_hypothesis: Pavement should be low and wide. Sand and salt (calcium chloride) are usually scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

source: گردباد ستونی چرخنده از هوای بسیار کم فشار است که هوای اطراف را به سمت داخل و بالا می کشد.
english_gold: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.
english_hypothesis: A tornado is a columnar rotating air mass that descends from the sky and pulls the surrounding air towards its center and upwards.

source: آنها از ابرهای طوفانی قیف استوانه ای شکل پایین آمده و هنگام تماس با زمین تبدیل به "گردباد" می شوند.
english_gold: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.
english_hypothesis: They descend from cylindrical cone-shaped storm clouds and become "tornadoes" upon contact with the ground.

source: گردبادها بادهایی شدید ایجاد می کنند (غالباً 100-200 مایل در ساعت) و می توانند اجسام سنگین را به هوا بالا کنند و آنها را هنگام حرکت حمل کنند.
english_gold: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.
english_hypothesis: Tornadoes are extremely powerful winds (often reaching 100-200 miles per hour) that can lift heavy objects into the air and carry them along as they move.

source: گردبادها در مقایسه با طوفان های شدید دیگر منطقه کوچکی را تحت تاثیر قرار می دهند، اما می توانند هر چیزی در مسیر خود را نابود کنند.
english_gold: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.
english_hypothesis: Tornadoes, in comparison to other severe storms in the region, affect a relatively small area, but they can destroy anything in their path.

source: گردبادها درختان را از ریشه کنده، تخته ها را از تعمیرها جدا کرده و موترها را در آسمان به پرواز در می آورند. دو فی صد شدیدترین گردبادها بیش از سه ساعت طول می کشند.
english_gold: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.
english_hypothesis: Tornadoes uproot trees, tear off roofs, and send cars flying through the air. The two most intense tornadoes last for over three hours.

source: این طوفان های وحشتناک دارای سرعت بادی تا 480 کیلومتر بر ساعت (133 m/s؛ 300 مایل در ساعت) می باشند.
english_gold: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
english_hypothesis: These terrifying storms have wind speeds of up to 480 kilometers per hour (133 meters per second; 300 miles per hour).

source: آب و هوای شدید یک اصطلاح عمومی برای هر پدیده آب و هوایی خطرناک است که می تواند باعث آسیب، اختلال جدی اجتماعی یا از دست دادن جان انسان شود.
english_gold: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
english_hypothesis: Severe weather is a general term for any hazardous weather phenomenon that can cause damage, severe social disruption, or loss of human life.

source: آب و هوای شدید می تواند در هر نقطه از جهان رخ دهد و انواع مختلفی از آن وجود دارد که به جغرافیا، توپوگرافی و شرایط جوی بستگی دارد.
english_gold: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
english_hypothesis: Weather can be severe in any part of the world and comes in various forms, depending on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.

source: بادهای شدید، ژاله، بارش بیش از حد و آتش سوزی های وحش از جمله شکل ها و آثار آب و هوای شدید، مانند رعد و برق ها، گردبادها، آبگیرها و طوفان ها هستند.
english_gold: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
english_hypothesis: Severe winds, hail, excessive rainfall, and devastating wildfires are among the forms and effects of severe weather, similar to thunderstorms, tornadoes, floods, and hurricanes.

source: پدیده های شدید جوی و فصلی شامل کولاک، طوفان برف، طوفان یخ و طوفان گرد و غبار است.
english_gold: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
english_hypothesis: Severe weather phenomena and seasonal events include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.

source: جریان های گرداب جریان برگشتی موج هایی است که اغلب روی یک صخره یا موارد مشابه از ساحل جدا می شوند.
english_gold: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
english_hypothesis: Rip currents are waves that often break off from the shore, like a rock or similar, and flow back to the sea.

source: با توجه به توپولوژی زیر آب، جریان برگشتی در چند قسمت عمیق تر متمرکز شده و ممکن جریان سریع به آب های عمیق در آنجا ایجاد شود.
english_gold: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
english_hypothesis: The backflow is concentrated in several deep parts due to the underwater topography, and it is possible that a fast current will form in the deep water there.

source: بیشتر مرگ ها در نتیجه خستگی هنگام تلاش برای برگشت با آب بازی خلاف جریان رخ می دهد، که ممکن امکان ناپذیر باشد.
english_gold: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
english_hypothesis: Most deaths occur due to exhaustion while trying to swim against the current, which may be impossible.

source: به محض خروج از جریان، آب بازی به عقب دشوارتر از حالت عادی نیست.
english_gold: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
english_hypothesis: Water play is no more difficult to reverse than normal after exiting the flow.

source: زیردریایی ها در جنگ جهانی اول و دوم استفاده شدند. در آن وقت آنها بسیار ضعیف بودند و جای بسیار کمی برای فیر داشتند.

source: بخاطر پیروزی آنها با زیردریایی ها، پس از جنگ آلمانی ها به داشتن تعداد زیاد آنها اعتماد نمی کنند.

source: بلی! پادشاه توتنخامون، که گاهی اوقات به عنوان "پادشاه تُت" یا "پادشاه بچه" شناخته می شود، یکی از شناخته شده ترین پادشاهان مصر باستان در دوران مدرن است.

source: بیشتر اشیایی که با توتنخانمون دفن شده اند به خوبی نگهداری شده اند، بشمول هزاران اثر باستانی ساخته شده از فلزات گرانبها و سنگ های نایاب.

source: انسان‌ها برای هزاران سال از عدسیه ها برای بزرگنمایی استفاده کرده اند.

source: شروع تایوان از قرن 15هم آغاز شد جاییکه کشتی رانان اروپایی با گذر از آنجا نام این جزیره را الهه فارموسا، یا جزیره زیبا ثبت کردند.

source: در 1624، شرکت هند شرقی هالندی در جنوب غربی تایوان یک پایگاه میسازد، تغییراتی را در شیوه های برزیدن تولید حبوبات بومی آورد و کارگران چینی را در مزارع برنج و شکر خود شامل کار ساخت.

english_hypothesis: The power has affected all, from the king to the ordinary man.
