source: این بعضی اوقات-سواحل مملو از بیروبار فامیلی با زنجیره خوب از فروشگاه‌ها که در کنار ساحل صف بسته اند میباشد. آب بازی بی خطر است.
english_gold: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
english_hypothesis: This beach is sometimes crowded with families, lined up in a good chain of shops along the shore. The water play is safe.

source: فنلند یک مقصد عالی کشتی‌رانی است. "سرزمین هزار دریاچه" همچنان هزارها جزیره، در دریاچه‌ها و در مجمع الجزایر ساحلی دارد.
english_gold: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
english_hypothesis: Finland is a wonderful destination for sailing. "The Land of a Thousand Lakes" still has thousands of islands, both in the lakes and in the coastal archipelago.

source: در مجمع الجزایر و دریاچه‌ها شما لزوماً به یک قایق نیاز ندارید.
english_gold: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
english_hypothesis: You don't necessarily need a boat to explore the islands and lakes.

source: درحالیکه مجمع الجزایر ساحلی و بزرگترین دریاچه‌ها در حقیقت برای هر نوع قایق کافیست، کشتی‌های کوچک یا حتی یک قایق یک تجربه متفاوت را ارائه میکند.
english_gold: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
english_hypothesis: While the assembly of coastal islands and the largest lakes in fact suffices for any type of boat, small ships or even a single boat offer a different experience.

source: کشتی‌رانی یک سرگرمی ملی در فنلند با یک کشتی برای هر هفت یا هشت نفر می‌باشد.
english_gold: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
english_hypothesis: Sailing is a national pastime in Finland, where one boat is used for every seven or eight people.

source: پارک ملی دریاچه های Plitvice دارای جنگل های وسیع، عمدتاً با درختان راش، صنوبر و شاه درخت است و از ترکیب پوشش گیاهی آلپی و مدیترانه ای برخوردار است.
english_gold: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
english_hypothesis: The Plitvice Lakes National Park features extensive forests, mainly composed of beech, oak, and pine trees, and is characterized by a combination of alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.

source: این منطقه به دلیل طیف اقلیم های خرد، خاک های متفاوت و سطوح متفاوت ارتفاع، تنوع قابل توجهی از جوامع گیاهی را داراست.
english_gold: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
english_hypothesis: This region has a notable diversity of plant communities due to the variety of climates, different soils, and varying elevations.

source: همچنان این منطقه منزلگاه انواع بسیار متنوعی از حیوانات و گونه های پرندگان است.
english_gold: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
english_hypothesis: This region is home to a wide variety of animals and bird species.

source: حیوانات کمیابی مانند خرس قهوه ای اروپایی، گرگ، عقاب، بوف، سیاه گوش، گربه وحشی و سرخپوش به همراه بسیاری از گونه های رایج دیگر در آنجا یافت می شود.
english_gold: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
english_hypothesis: Wildlife species such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, bison, black bear, wildcat, and lynx, along with many other common species, can be found there.

source: بعضی افراد بر این باورند که تجربه بسیاری از رویاهای شفاف القا شده مصنوعی اغلب به اندازه کافی میتواند بسیار خسته کننده باشد.
english_gold: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.
english_hypothesis: Some people believe that experiencing many lucid dreams, which are often artificially induced, can be very monotonous.

source: با REM های کمتر در شب، این حالت که در آن خواب واقعی را تجربه می کنید و بدن شما بهبود می یابد به اندازه ای نادر می شود که مشکل ساز شود.
english_gold: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.
english_hypothesis: With fewer REMs in the night, the state in which you experience real sleep and your body recovers becomes so rare that it becomes a problem.

source: این بهمان اندازه خسته کننده است که گویی هر بیست یا سی دقیقه یکبار از خواب بیدار می شوید و تلویزیون تماشا میکنید.
english_gold: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.
english_hypothesis: This is as monotonous as waking up every 20 or 30 minutes from sleep and watching TV.

source: این تاثیر بستگی به این دارد که هر شب چقدر مغز شما تلاش می کند تا خواب شفاف ببیند.
english_gold: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.
english_hypothesis: This effect depends on how hard your brain tries to see clear dreams every night.

source: افرادی که برای چندین دهه مشارکت داشتند، ضمن ارزیابی صادقانه مشکلات و حتی ناکامی ها به ما کمک کردند تا تونایی و علایق خود را درک کنیم.
english_gold: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.
english_hypothesis: Individuals who have been involved for several decades, through honest assessment of challenges and even failures, have helped us to understand our capabilities and interests.

source: در حین گوش دادن به افرادی که داستان های فردی، خانوادگی و سازمانی خویش را شریک می کردند بینش ارزشمندی از گذشته و برخی از شخصیت هایی که بر فرهنگ سازمان تاثیر خوب یا بد گذاشته اند را به دست آوردیم.
english_gold: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.
english_hypothesis: We gained valuable insights into the past and some of the characters who have had a good or bad impact on the organization's culture by listening to individuals who shared their personal, family, and organizational stories.

source: در حالی که دانستن تاریخچه یک فرد به معنای درک فرهنگ پنداشته نمی شود، حداقل به افراد کمک می کند تا جایگاه شان را در گذشته سازمان درک کنند.
english_gold: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.
english_hypothesis: Knowing a person's history does not necessarily mean understanding their culture, but it at least helps individuals understand their place within the organization's past.

source: در هنگام ارزیابی کامیابی ها و آگاه شدن از ناکامی ها، افراد و افراد اشتراک کننده ارزش ها، ماموریت و نیروهای محرک سازمان را به طور عمیق تری در می یابند.
english_gold: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.
english_hypothesis: When evaluating successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and those who share values, mission, and driving forces of the organization, gain a deeper understanding of it.

source: در این نمونه، یادآوری مثال های قبلی رفتار کارآفرینانه و موفقیت های به دست آمده به مردم کمک کرد تا برای تغییرات جدید و رهبری جدید برای کلیسای محلی آماده باشند.
english_gold: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.
english_hypothesis: In this instance, recalling previous entrepreneurial behavior and successes achieved helped people prepare for the new changes and new leadership in the local church.

source: این داستان های موفقیت آمیز ترس از تغییر را کاهش داد، در حالی که تمایلات مثبتی را برای تحول در آینده ایجاد می کرد.
english_gold: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.
english_hypothesis: This narrative successfully reduced the fear of change, while fostering positive inclinations towards transformation in the future.

source: رویکرد پسا مدرن برای یادگیری رهایی از قطعیات را ارائه می دهد. تنها یک راه خوب یادگیری وجود ندارد.
english_gold: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.
english_hypothesis: This postmodern approach to learning offers a way to break free from dogmatic thinking. There is no single good way to learn.

source: در حقیقت، تنها یک چیز خوب برای یادگیری وجود ندارد. یادگیری در زمان تجربه میان یادگیرنده و دانش ارائه شده صورت می گیرد.
english_gold: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.
english_hypothesis: In reality, there is only one good thing for learning: learning in the process of experiencing, between the learner and the knowledge presented.

source: تجربه فعلی ما با خودتان-تمام-آن-را-انجام-دهید (do-it-yourself) و ارائه معلومات، و نمایش های یادگیری تلویزیونی بر این نکته تاکید می کند.
english_gold: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.
english_hypothesis: Our current experience is a do-it-yourself project, and the emphasis is on providing information and showcasing television learning programs.

source: بسیاری از ما خود را در حال تماشای یک برنامه تلویزیونی می یابیم که ما را از پروسه ای یا تجربه ای مطلع می کند که هرگز در آن شرکت نخواهیم کرد یا دانش آن را استفاده نخواهیم کرد.
english_gold: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.
english_hypothesis: Many of us are watching a TV program that informs us about a process or experience that we will never be a part of or use the knowledge of.

source: ما هرگز موتر خود را اوراق نخواهیم کرد، فواره آبی را در حویلی خود نخواهیم ساخت، و برای دیدن ویرانه های باستانی به پرو سفر نخواهیم کرد یا خانه همسایه خود را تغییر مدل نمی دهیم.
english_gold: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.
english_hypothesis: We will never register our car, we will not build a fountain in our courtyard, and we will not travel to Peru to see ancient ruins, nor will we change the model of our neighbor's house.

source: اجبار گرایی تکنالوژیکی یک اصطلاح است که شامل ساحه وسیع از تفکرات در جامه عمل میشود، از فشار تکنالوژی یا شروط آن به معنای دقیق که سرنوشت انسان را بر اساس منطق نهفته در قوانین علمی در آن رقم می زند تا نمایان شدن آنها در تکنالوژی.
english_gold: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
english_hypothesis: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a broad range of thoughts in practice, from the pressure of technology or its conditions, meaning exactly that human destiny is determined by the logic hidden in scientific laws, to their manifestation in technology.

source: تفاسیر اکثر جبر گرایی تخنیکی اکثراً بیانگر دو مفهوم عمومی است: اینکه توسعه تکنالوژی بخودی خود راه خیلی فراتر از نفوذ فرهنگی یا سیاسی را می پیماید، و تکنالوژی نیز به نوبه خود بر جوامع از نظر اجتماعی بحالت دلخواه در آورده شده نسبت به جوامع طبیعی "اثرات" آشکار دارد.
english_gold: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
english_hypothesis: Most interpretations of determinism, technical or otherwise, convey two general ideas: that technological development, in and of itself, traverses a path far beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology, in turn, has brought about a desired state in societies, in contrast to natural communities.

source: بطور مثال، کسی شاید بگوید که موترها لزوماً منتج به توسعه سرک ها میشود.
english_gold: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
english_hypothesis: For example, someone might say that cars necessarily lead to the development of roads.

source: خریداری بیشمار از موترها سبب بوجود آمدن حادثات در سرک ها میشود که این امر باعث اختراع تخنیک های جدید در مراقبت های صحی برای تداوی افراد مجروح گردیده است.
english_gold: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
english_hypothesis: The frequent purchase of cars has led to accidents on roads, which has prompted the invention of new techniques in emergency care for treating injured individuals.

source: فرهنگ های خورد افراد همفکر را دور هم می آوردند که فکر می کنند استانداردهای اجتماعی نادیده گرفته شده و به آنها اجازه می دهد حس هویت را توسعه دهند.
english_gold: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
english_hypothesis: This sentence translates to: "Cultural practices bring people with similar thoughts together, who feel that social standards have been overlooked and allow them to develop a sense of identity."

source: فرهنگ های خورد به دلیل سن، قومیت، طبقه، مکان و / یا جنسیت اعضا می توانند متفاوت باشند.
english_gold: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
english_hypothesis: Cultural practices can vary among members due to age, ethnicity, social class, location, and/or gender.

source: خصوصیات که یک فرهنگ کوچک را تفکیک می کند ممکن است زبانی، زیبایی شناختی، مذهبی، سیاسی، جنسی، جغرافیایی یا ترکیبی از عوامل باشد.
english_gold: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
english_hypothesis: The characteristics that distinguish a small culture may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, gender, geographical, or a combination of these factors.

source: اعضای یک فرهنگ کوچک معمولاٌ عضویت خود را از طریق استفاده متمایز و نمادین از سبک، که شامل مُد، رفتار و آرگوت است، نشان میدهند.
english_gold: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
english_hypothesis: Members of a small culture usually indicate their membership through distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashion, behavior, and argot.

source: در حالیکه یادگیری نظر به پروژه باید یادگیری را آسان تر و جالب تر کند، تخته بندی یک گام فراتر می رود.
english_gold: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
english_hypothesis: While learning should be made easier and more interesting, taking into account the project, tabulation goes a step further.

source: تخته بندی یک روش یادگیری نیست، بلکه مفکوره ای است که برای افرادی که تجربه یادگیری جدیدی مانند استفاده از یک برنامه کمپیوتری جدید یا شروع یک پروژه جدید را تجربه می کنند، پشتیبانی میکند.
english_gold: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
english_hypothesis: This is not a method of learning, but rather a concept that supports individuals who are experiencing a new learning experience, such as using a new computer program or starting a new project.

source: تخته بندی ها هم مجازی و هم واقعی باشند، به عبارت دیگر، یک معلم نمونه ای از تخته بندی است، اما مرد کوچک گیره ای کاغذ در مایکروسافت نیز به همین شکل.
english_gold: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
english_hypothesis: Whiteboards can be both virtual and real, meaning a teacher is an example of a whiteboard, but so is a small paper clip in Microsoft.

source: تخته بندی های مجازی در نرم افزار درونی شده اند و به منظور پرسش، در خواست و توضیح رویه هایی هستند که ممکن است برای دانش آموز به تنهایی چالش برانگیز باشد.
english_gold: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
english_hypothesis: The virtual whiteboards in the software are integrated to facilitate inquiry, request, and explanation of procedures that may be challenging for a student to tackle alone.

source: وقفه خواب پروسه بیدار شدن هدفمند در طول دوره خواب عادی و به خواب رفتن مدت کوتاهی بعدی (10 تا 60 دقیقه) است.
english_gold: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
english_hypothesis: Wakefulness is a process of becoming conscious during a normal sleep period, and it is a brief period (10 to 60 minutes) before falling asleep again.

source: این کار را می توان به راحتی با استفاده از یک ساعت زنگ دار نسبتاٌ آرام انجام داد تا شما را بدون بیدار کردن کامل به هوش بیاورد.
english_gold: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
english_hypothesis: This task can be easily done with a relatively quiet alarm clock to wake you up without fully waking you up.

source: اگر متوجه شدید که ساعت را در خواب تنظیم مجدد میکنید، می توانید آن را در طرف دیگر اتاق قرار دهید تا مجبور شوید از رختخواب بلند شوید تا آن را خاموش کنید.
english_gold: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
english_hypothesis: If you find yourself setting the alarm clock again in your sleep, you can place it on the other side of the room so you have to get out of bed to turn it off.

source: دیگر انتخاب های مستلزم بیوریتم شامل نوشیدن مقدار زیادی مایعات (مخصوصاٌ آب یا چای، یک دیورتیک شناخته شده) قبل از خواب است که فرد را مجبور به بلند شدن برای ادرار می کند.
english_gold: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
english_hypothesis: Drinking a large amount of fluids, especially water or tea, before bed, which is a known diuretic, forces the individual to get up to urinate.

source: تئوری های محتوا، برای یافتن چیزی که باعث می شود مردم آن را علامت صحیح بزنند یا آنها را جذب کند، متمرکز شده اند.
english_gold: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
english_hypothesis: Theories of content have focused on finding what makes people tick, what gets them to click the right button or be drawn to it.

source: این تئوری ها نشان می دهند که افراد نیازها و/ یا خواسته های خاص دارند که در طول رشد به بزرگسالی درونی شده اند.
english_gold: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
english_hypothesis: These theories indicate that individuals have specific needs and/or desires that have developed over time as they mature into adulthood.

source: این تئوری ها در مورد برخی افراد معین به این موضوع می پردازد که چه چیزی باعث می شود آنها بخواهند کارهایی را انجام بدهند و چه چیزهایی در محیط شان آنها را وادار به انجام یا عدم انجام برخی کارها می کند.
english_gold: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
english_hypothesis: This theory deals with certain individuals and what motivates them to perform certain actions, and what factors in their environment compel them to do or not do certain things.

source: دو تئوری محتوای مشهور نظریه سلسله مراتب نیازهای مازلو و نظریه دو عاملی هرزبرگ می باشند.
english_gold: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
english_hypothesis: The two well-known theories of content are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs and Herzberg's Two-Factor Theory.

source: به طور کلی، وقتی که مدیران شروع به رهبری همتایان سابق خود می کنند، دو نوع رفتار پدیدار می شود. یک طرف طیف سعی می کند "یکی از خود" (یا خانم ها) بماند.
english_gold: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
english_hypothesis: When managers start leading their former peers, two types of behavior emerge. One end of the spectrum tries to "stay the same" (or "act like one of the guys").

source: این نوع مدیر در گرفتن تصمیم های غیر محبوب، انجام اقدامات انضباطی، ارزیابی عملکرد، تعیین مسئولیت و پاسخگو قرار دادن افراد مشکل دارد.
english_gold: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
english_hypothesis: This type of manager struggles with unpopular decisions, disciplinary actions, performance evaluations, assigning responsibilities, and holding individuals accountable.

source: در طرف دیگر طیف، شخص به فردی غیرقابل شناسایی تبدیل می شود که احساس می کند باید تمام آن چیزی که تیم انجام می داده است را تغییر بدهد و آن را مال خود بکند.
english_gold: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
english_hypothesis: On the other side of the spectrum, the person becomes someone unrecognizable, feeling the need to change everything the team has done and make it their own.

source: به هر حال، در نهایت رهبر مسئول کامیابی و ناکامی تیم می باشد.
english_gold: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
english_hypothesis: The leader is ultimately responsible for the team's success or failure.

source: این رفتار اغلب منجر به شکاف بین رهبران و سایر اعضای تیم می‌شود.
english_gold: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
english_hypothesis: This behavior often leads to a rift between leaders and other team members.

source: چرا باید سازمانی بخواهد پروسه زمان گیر تاسیس یک سازمان یادگیرنده را طی نماید؟ یکی از اهداف به کارگیری مفاهیم آموزش سازمانی نوآوری می باشد.
english_gold: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
english_hypothesis: Why would an organization want to go through the time-consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One of the goals of adopting organizational learning concepts is innovation.

source: زمانی که تمام منابع موجود به طور موثر در تمام دیپارتمنت های فعال یک سازمان استفاده شود، خلاقیت و ابتکار عمل به دست خواهد آمد.
english_gold: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
english_hypothesis: When all available resources are utilized effectively across all active departments of an organization, creativity and initiative will be generated.

source: در نتیجه، پروسه همکاری در سازمان برای غلبه بر یک مانع می تواند منجر به یک پروسه مبتکرانه جدید برای عرضه خدمات به مشتری گردد.
english_gold: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
english_hypothesis: As a result, the process of collaboration within the organization to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process for delivering services to customers.

source: قبل از اینکه یک سازمان بتواند مبتکر باشد، رهبری سازمان باید فرهنگ نوآوری و همچنین دانش مشترک و یادگیری سازمانی را ایجاد کند.
english_gold: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
english_hypothesis: Before an organization can be innovative, its leadership must create a culture of innovation, as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.

source: آنجل (2006)، رویکرد تسلسل را به عنوان روشی که برای کمک به سازمان ها در رسیدن به سطح بالاتر اجراات به کار برده می شود تشریح می کند.
english_gold: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.
english_hypothesis: Angel (2006) explains the approach of iteration as a method used to help organizations reach a higher level of execution.

source: جستجوی اینترنت برای "دوره محیط خصمانه" احتمالاً آدرس یک کمپنی محلی را ارائه می دهد.
english_gold: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
english_hypothesis: Internet search for "Hostile Environment Course" may yield the address of a local company.

source: یک دوره به طور معمول تمام موضوعات مورد بحث در اینجا را با جزئیات بسیار بیشتر، معمولاً با تجربه عملی، پوشش خواهد داد.
english_gold: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
english_hypothesis: This course will cover all the topics discussed here in much greater detail, usually with practical experience.

source: یک دوره معمولاً بین 5-2 روز خواهد بود و شامل نقش آفرینی، بسیاری از کمک های اولیه و گاهی آموزش سلاح می شود.
english_gold: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
english_hypothesis: A typical course usually lasts between 5-2 days and includes role-playing, many first aid techniques, and sometimes firearms training.

source: کتاب ها و مجلات مرتبط با نجات یافتن در طبیعت وحش رایج هستند، اما نشریاتی که به مناطق جنگی می پردازند کم هستند.
english_gold: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
english_hypothesis: Books and magazines related to survival in the wilderness are common, but publications dealing with war zones are scarce.

source: موارد زیادی وجود دارد که باید قبل و هنگام سفر به جایی در نظر بگیرید.
english_gold: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.
english_hypothesis: There are many things to consider before and during a trip to a place.

source: وقتی مسافرت می کنید، انتظار نداشته باشید همه چیز مانند "کشور خودتان" باشد. رفتارها، قوانین، غذا، ترافیک، محل اقامت، استندردها، زبان و غیره تا حدودی با محل زندگی شما متفاوت است.
english_gold: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.
english_hypothesis: When traveling, do not expect everything to be like "your own country." Behaviors, laws, food, traffic, accommodations, standards, language, and so on are somewhat different from your home.

source: این چیزی است که همیشه باید به منظور پرهیز از ناامیدی یا حتی انزجار از روش های محلی انجام کارها به خاطر بسپارید.
english_gold: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.
english_hypothesis: This is something that you should always keep in mind to avoid disappointment or even disgust with local methods.

source: اگر برای اولین بار به کشوری در حال توسعه سفر می کنید - یا در قسمت جدیدی از جهان - شوک فرهنگی احتمالی را دست کم نگیرید.
english_gold: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.
english_hypothesis: When traveling to a developing country or a new part of the world for the first time, don't underestimate the potential cultural shock.

source: بسیاری از مسافران با ثبات و توانمند بر تازگی سفرهای در حال توسعه جهان غلبه کرده اند، جایی که بسیاری از تغییرات فرهنگی کوچک می تواند به سرعت اضافه گردد.
english_gold: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.
english_hypothesis: Many travelers with stability and power have overcome the freshness of the world's developing travel, where many small cultural changes can be added quickly.

source: به ویژه در روزهای ابتدایی خود، به دنبال ولخرجی در به سبک غربی و هوتل های با کیفیت، غذا و خدمات برای کمک به سازگاری باشید.
english_gold: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.
english_hypothesis: In the early days, look for value for money in Western-style hotels and restaurants, and services to help with the transition.

source: مجوزها باید پیش از وقت رزرو گردند. شما برای شب ماندن در سیرنا باید مجوز داشته باشید.
english_gold: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.
english_hypothesis: You must reserve your permits in advance. You will need a permit to stay overnight in Sirena.

source: دریافت مستقیم مجوزهای پارک از ایستگاه محیط بانی در پورتو خیمنز امکانپذیر است، اما آنها کریدت کارت قبول نمی کنند.
english_gold: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards
english_hypothesis: Directly obtaining park permits from the Environment Station in Puerto Jimenez is possible, but they do not accept credit cards.

source: سرویس پارک (MINAE) مجوز پارک را بیش از یک ماه قبل از ورود پیش بینی شده صادر نمی کند.
english_gold: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.
english_hypothesis: MINAE does not issue a park permit more than a month before the expected entry date.

source: کافی نت ال سول (CafeNet El Sol) خدمات رزرو را با هزینه 30 دالر آمریکایی یا 10 دالر برای کارت های یک روزه ارائه می دهد؛ جزئیات در صفحه Corcovado آنها موجود است.
english_gold: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.
english_hypothesis: CafeNet El Sol offers reservation services for $30 or $10 for one-day cards; details are available on their Corcovado page.

source: انترنت عناصر هر دو هم ارتباطات جمعی و هم درون فردی را با هم ترکیب می‌کند.
english_gold: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
english_hypothesis: The Internet combines both interpersonal and intrapersonal communication.

source: ویژگی‌های متمایز انترنت از نظر روش کاربردها و سپاسگزاری‌ ها منتج به ابعاد اضافی شد.
english_gold: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
english_hypothesis: The distinctive features of the Internet, in terms of its applications and user interfaces, have led to additional dimensions.

source: بطور نمونه، آموزش و روابط اجتماعی برقرار کردن برای کاربرد انترنت منحیث انگیزه‌ های مهم پیشنهاد گردیده است (جیمز و همکاران 1995).
english_gold: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
english_hypothesis: For example, education and social relationships have been suggested as important motivators for the use of the Internet (James et al., 1995).

source: ”گرفتاری شخصی“ و ”روابط متداوم“ همچنان بحیث ابعاد جدید انگیزه‌دهی توسط ایگمی و مک‌کورد (1998) زمانیکه آنها عکس العمل مخاطبین را به صفحات انترنتی بررسی کردند شناسایی شدند.
english_gold: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
english_hypothesis: "Personal difficulties" and "constant relationships" were identified as new dimensions of motivation by Igami and McCord (1998) when they examined the audience's reaction on the internet.

source: بنابراین، هنگامی که پنسیل اولین بار ساخته شد دوستی خوب برای بسیاری از افراد بود.
english_gold: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
english_hypothesis: Therefore, when the first pencil was made, it was a good friend to many people.

source: متاسفانه، با پیدایش روش های جدیدتر نوشتن، پنسیل به مقام پایین تر و استفاده کمتری رسیده است.
english_gold: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
english_hypothesis: Unfortunately, with the advent of newer writing methods, the pencil has come to occupy a lower position and is used less.

source: اکنون مردم پیام ها را روی صفحه کمپیوتر می نویسند، و دیگر مجبور به استفاده از پنسیل تراش نیستند.
english_gold: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
english_hypothesis: Now people write messages on the computer screen, and they no longer need to use a whiteboard.

source: تنها میتوان حیران ماند که وقتی کدام چیز جدیدتری پدید آید کیبورد چه خواهد شد.
english_gold: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
english_hypothesis: It is only natural to be bewildered when one wonders what the keyboard will become when something newer appears.

source: تیم های مجازی دارای معیار کیفیت مشابه با تیم های معمولی می باشند، اما تفاوت های ظریفی بین آنها وجود دارد.
english_gold: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
english_hypothesis: Virtual teams have similar quality standards to regular teams, but there are subtle differences between them.

source: اعضای تیم مجازی اغلب من حیث شخص ارتباطی گروپ فیزیکی خود عمل می کنند.
english_gold: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
english_hypothesis: Members of the virtual team often act as a physical group in their personal capacity.

source: آنها اغلب نسبت به اعضای تیم معمولی خود دارای استقلال بیشتری می باشند چون ممکن تیم هایشان با توجه به مناطق مختلف زمانی ملاقات کنند، که ممکن است توسط مدیران محلی آنها درک نشود.
english_gold: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
english_hypothesis: They often have more independence from their regular team members because their teams may meet at different times depending on the regions, which may not be understood by their local managers.

source: حضور یک "تیم نامرئی" واقعی (لارسون و لافاستو، 1989، ص 109) همچنان یک جزء منحصر به فرد تیم مجازی است.
english_gold: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
english_hypothesis: The presence of a "ghost team" (Larson & LaFasto, 1989, p. 109) remains a unique component of virtual teams.

source: ویبسایت این استیشن از نمایش به عنوان "تیاتر رادیویی با چرخش عجیب و غریب جدید و زشت مکتب قدیمی" یاد میکند.
english_gold: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"
english_hypothesis: This website refers to the station's broadcasts as "a strange and ugly new twist on the old school of radio theatre."

source: در روزهای نخست خود، برنامه منحصراً در سایت طولانی مدت قدیمی رادیویی انترنیتی، رادیوی توگی نت، سایتی که به گفتگوی رادیو مختص بود، نمایش داده شد.
english_gold: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.
english_hypothesis: My program was initially broadcast on the old Radio Internet Site, Togi Net, a website exclusively dedicated to radio talk.

source: توگی نت در اواخر سال 2015، رادیوی آسترونت را به عنوان یک پایگاه‌ فرعی تأسیس کرد.
english_gold: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.
english_hypothesis: In late 2015, Toegi Net established Radio Astron as a subsidiary.

source: در اوایل، نمایش مخصوص هنرمندان آماتور صدا از شرق تگزاس بود.
english_gold: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
english_hypothesis: In the beginning, the show was specifically for amateur artists from East Texas.

source: فراتر از حادثه چهارشنبه، کارپینیدو در دو مسابقه انفرادی در قهرمانی ها رقابت کرد.
english_gold: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.
english_hypothesis: Carapino competed in two individual events at the championships after the Wednesday incident.

source: مسابقه نخست اش سلالوم بود، جاییکه او در دوش نخست اش تکمیل نکرد را بدست آورد. 36 رقابت کننده از جمله 116 اشتراک کننده نتایج همسان در مسابقه داشتند.
english_gold: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.
english_hypothesis: His first competition was a slalom, where he finished last. 36 competitors, including 116 participants, had the same results in the competition.

source: مسابقه دیگر او، سلالوم بزرگ، دیده شد که او در گروه زنان در مکان دهم با زمان دوش مجموعی 4:41.30، 2:11.60 دقیقه آهسته تر از تمام کننده مکان اول اشتراک کننده اتریشی کلاودیا لوسیک و 1:09.02 دقیقه آهسته تر از تمام کننده مقام نهم گیونجی دانی از هنگری تمام کرد.
english_gold: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.
english_hypothesis: Her other competition, the giant slalom, was seen where she finished tenth in the women's group with a total time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than Austrian finisher Claudia Lucik who took first place and 1:09.02 minutes slower than Hungarian finisher Gyongyi Daniel who took ninth place.

source: چهار زن سکی باز در گروه زنان مؤفق به تمام کردن دوش های شان نشدند، و 45 سکی باز از جمله 117 اشتراک کننده در سلالوم بزرگ قادر نبودند تا مکان را در مسابقه برای خود برنده شوند.
english_gold: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
english_hypothesis: Four female skiers in the women's group were unable to complete their runs, and 45 skiers, including 117 participants, were unable to secure a place in the competition.

source: "Panama Papers" یک اصطلاح جامع برای تقریباً ده میلیون اسناد از شرکت حقوقی پانامی Mossack Fonseca است که در بهار سال 2016 به مطبوعات فاش شد.
english_gold: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.
english_hypothesis: The Panama Papers is a comprehensive term for nearly 11 million documents from the Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca that were leaked to the press in the spring of 2016.

source: اسناد نشان داد که چهارده بانک با مشتریان ثروتمند کمک کردنند تا ثروت بیلیون ها دالر امریکایی را پنهان کند تا از پرداخت مالیات و سایر مقررات جلوگیری کند.
english_gold: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.
english_hypothesis: Fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars from tax and regulatory authorities.

source: روزنامه بریتانوی گاردین پیشنهاد کرد که بانک دویچ تقریباً قسمت سوم 1200 شرکت پوست که بخاطر انجام این استفاده را کنترول کرده است.
english_gold: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.
english_hypothesis: The British newspaper The Guardian suggested that Deutsche Bank has almost complete control over the third part of 1,200 companies that have been used for this purpose.

source: تظاهرات در تمام جهان صورت گرفت، چندین تعقیب جنایی و رهبران هر دو دولت آیسلند و پاکستان استعفا دادند.
english_gold: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.
english_hypothesis: Protests took place across the world, and several criminal pursuits and the leaders of both the Icelandic and Pakistani governments resigned.

source: به گفته مردم که شخص یک موتر سه-تایر را مملو از مواد انفجاری به انبوه از مردم داخل نموده است.
english_gold: The man allegedly drove a three-wheeled vehicle armed with explosives into a crowd.
english_hypothesis: According to the people, a person has filled a three-wheeled motor vehicle with explosives and driven it into a crowd of people.

source: مرد که مشکوک به انفجار بود، بعد از برداشت جراحات ناشی از انفجار دستگیر شده است.
english_gold: The man suspected of detonating the bomb was detained, after sustaining injuries from the blast.
english_hypothesis: The man, who was suspicious of an explosion, was arrested after sustaining injuries from the blast.

source: به مقامات اسم او تا حالا معلوم نیست، درحالیکه آنها میدانند که عضوی از گروه قومی اویغور میباشد.
english_gold: His name is still unknown to authorities, although they do know he is a member of the Uighur ethnic group.
english_hypothesis: His name is still unknown to the authorities, while they are aware that he is a member of the Uyghur ethnic group.

source: تلفات مرگ حداقل 15 نفر است، ارقام که انتظار میرود بالا برود.
english_gold: The death toll is at least 15, a figure which is expected to rise.
english_hypothesis: The death toll is at least 15, and is expected to rise.

source: امروزه در کشورهای توسعه یافته، ارائه تخت و صبحانه های تجملی به نوعی هنر تبدیل شده است.
english_gold: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.
english_hypothesis: Today, in developed countries, presenting a bed and breakfast as a form of art has become a trend.

source: در پایان، بدون شک که B & B عمدتاً در دو مورد اصلی رقابت می کند: تختخواب و صبحانه.

source: آرژانتین به داشتن یکی از بهترین تیم ها و بازیکنان چوگان در جهان مشهور است.
english_gold: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
english_hypothesis: Argentina is renowned for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.

source: بزرگترین تورنمنت سال در ماه دسمبر در میدان های چوگان در لاس کانیتاس برگزار می شود.
english_gold: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
english_hypothesis: The largest tournament of the year will take place in December at the polo fields in Las Canitas.

source: در دیگر مواقع سال تورنمنت ها و مسابقات کوچکتر را نیز می توانید در اینجا مشاهده کنید.
english_gold: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
english_hypothesis: You can also see smaller tournaments and competitions held here at other times of the year.

source: به منظور دریافت معلومات بیشتر در مورد مسابقات و محل خرید تکت مسابقات چوگان، انجمن چوگان آرژانتین را بررسی کنید.
english_gold: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
english_hypothesis: To get more information about the tournament and the location of the polo tournament, check the Argentine Polo Association.

source: مدت زیاد قبل از دیلی شو و راپور کولبرت، زمانیکه هیک و جانسن در UW در 1988 محصل بودنند در مورد یک نشریه تصور میکردنند که از اخبار-و گزارش اخبار تقلید کند.
english_gold: Long before The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, Heck and Johnson envisioned a publication that would parody the news—and news reporting—when they were students at UW in 1988.
english_hypothesis: Before Daily Show and The Colbert Report, in 1988, when Hickey and Johnson were students at UW, they imagined a magazine that would parody news and report news.

source: از زمان آغاز آن بدینسو، The Onion با یک نسخه چاپی، یک ویب سایت دارای 5,000,000 بینندگان بی همتا در ماه اکتوبر، اعلانات شخصی، یک شبکه 24 ساعته اخبار، پودکاست ها، و یک اطلس جهانی اخیراً عرضه شده به باراز که بنام Our Dumb World یاد می شود، به یک امپراتور حقیقی اخبار مبدل گردیده است.
english_gold: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.
english_hypothesis: Since its inception, The Onion has evolved into a true news empire with a print edition, a unique website with 5,000,000 monthly viewers in October, personal ads, a 24-hour news network, podcasts, and a recently released Our Dumb World atlas.

source: تعداد زیادی از نویسندگان آنها بالای نمایش های اخبار تمسخر آمیز جون ستیوارت و ستیفن کولبرت تاثیر زیاد داشتند.
english_gold: Many of their writers have gone on to wield great influence on Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert's news parody shows.
english_hypothesis: Many writers were influenced by the satirical news shows of Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert.

source: ال گور و جنرال تامی فرانکس اتفاقاً سرخط های دلخواه خود را به سرعت خواندند (گور هنگامیکه The Onion گزارش داد که او و تیپر بعد از شکست انتخابات سال 2000 کالج اش بهترین رابطه جنسی داشتند).
english_gold: Al Gore and General Tommy Franks casually rattle off their favorite headlines (Gore's was when The Onion reported he and Tipper were having the best sex of their lives after his 2000 Electoral College defeat).
english_hypothesis: The gor and General Tommy Franks coincidentally read their favorite headlines quickly (the gor when The Onion reported that he and the typist had the best sex after the 2000 election loss).

source: دروکگیال ژونگ یک قلعه ای ویران شده و صومعه ای بودایی در قسمت بالایی ناحیه پارو (در قریه فؤندی) است.
english_gold: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).
english_hypothesis: Drukgyel Dzong is a ruined fortress and a Buddhist monastery located in the upper part of the Paro valley (in the village of Fudzang).

source: گفته شده است که در 1649، ژدرونگ گاوانگ نمگییل قلعه را برای جشن پیروزی خود علیه نیروهای مغول های تبتی ساخت.
english_gold: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.
english_hypothesis: It is said that in 1649, Jandroong Gawanang Nemgiil built the Nemgiil Castle to celebrate his victory over the Tibetan Mongols.

source: در 1951، برخی آثار دروکگیال ژونگ مانند تصویر ژدرونگ گاوانگ نمگی یل در یک آتش سوزی از بین رفتند.
english_gold: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
english_hypothesis: In 1951, some of Drakgoel Jung's works, such as the painting "Zedron Gawan" by Namgyal, were destroyed in a fire.

source: بعد از آتش سوزی، قلعه نگهداری و محافظت شد، و همچنان یکی از جذابه های شورانگیز بوتان باقی ماند.
english_gold: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.
english_hypothesis: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, and it remains one of the captivating attractions of Bhutan.

source: معبد آرتمیس در ایفسوس در 21 جولای 356 قبل از میلاد در یک مراسم آتش سوزی توسط هروستراتوس ویران شد.
english_gold: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.
english_hypothesis: The Temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed by fire during a ceremony on July 21, 356 BCE, by Herostratus.

source: طبق داستان، انگیزه او باعث شهرت تمام عیارش شده بود. افیسیان ها خشمگین اعلام کردن که نام هروستراتوس هرگز ثبت نخواهد شد.
english_gold: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.
english_hypothesis: According to the story, his motivation had made him infamous. The Ephesians, enraged, declared that the name of Herostatus would never be recorded.

source: استرابو مورخ یونانی بعداٌ به این نام اشاره کرد که امروزه ما آن را می شناسیم. معبد در همان شبی که اسکندر مقدونی متولد شد ویران شد.
english_gold: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.
english_hypothesis: Strabo, the Greek historian, later referred to this name, which we recognize today. The temple was destroyed on the very night Alexander the Great was born.

source: اسکندر بحیث پادشاه، هزینه بازسازی معبد را پیشنهاد داد، اما پیشنهاد او رد شد. بعدها، پس از مرگ اسکندر، آن معبد در سال 323 قبل از میلاد بازسازی شد.
english_gold: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.
english_hypothesis: Alexander the Great, the king, proposed the cost of rebuilding the temple, but his proposal was rejected. Later, after Alexander's death, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BC.

source: نقاشی های دیواری یا خط خطی ناخواسته به عنوان دیوار نگاری شناخته می شود.
english_gold: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.
english_hypothesis: Street art or graffiti is known as wall painting.

source: در حالی که این پدیده از پدیده مدرن بودن فاصله دارد، احتمالاً اکثر مردم آن را با تخریب اموال عمومی و خصوصی با استفاده از رنگ اسپری توسط جوانان ارتباط می دهند.
english_gold: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.
english_hypothesis: While this phenomenon is far removed from modernity, most people associate it with the destruction of public and private property by spray-painting, a behavior commonly linked to young people.

source: با این حال، امروزه هنرمندان گرافیتی تثبیت شده، رویدادهای گرافیتی و دیوارهای "قانونی" وجود دارند. نقاشی های دیواری در این زمینه اغلب شبیه آثار هنری هستند تا برچسب های ناخوانا.
english_gold: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.
english_hypothesis: There are now established graffiti artists, graffiti events, and "legal" walls.

source: برخی از کشورها حتی برای اولین ارتکاب جرم مجازات های شدیدتری دارند؛ این موارد می تواند شامل بیش از 10 سال حبس یا اعدام باشد.
english_gold: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.
english_hypothesis: Some countries have even harsher punishments for first-time offenders; these can include more than 10 years in prison or the death penalty.

source: در خارج از ساوانا، مشکل است برای یک پستاندار با سیستم هاضمه مانند انسان نیازهای امینو اسید خود را از منابع گیاهی موجوده برآورده کند.
english_gold: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
english_hypothesis: In the savanna, it is difficult for a mammal with a digestive system similar to that of humans to meet its amino acid needs from the available plant sources.

source: در دسترس ترین منابع گیاهی، پروتین های قابل دسترس در برگ ها و حبوبات بودند، اما هضم آنها برای پستاندارانی مانند ما سخت است مگر اینکه پخته شوند.
english_gold: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
english_hypothesis: The most accessible plant-based sources of protein were leaves and legumes, but digesting them for us mammals is difficult unless they are cooked.

source: در مقابل، غذاهای حیوانی (مورچه ها، موریانه ها، تخم مرغ) نه تنها به راحتی قابل هضم هستند، بلکه پروتین هایی با مقدار زیادی را فراهم میکنند که حاوی تمام امینو اسید ضروری هستند.
english_gold: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
english_hypothesis: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) are not only easily digestible, but also provide a significant amount of protein that contains all the essential amino acids.

source: با در نظر گرفتن همه چیز، ما نباید تعجب کنیم اگر اجداد خودمان "مشکل پروتین" خود را تا حدودی به همان روشی که شامپانزده های موجود در ساوانا امروز حل میکنند، حل کرده اند.
english_gold: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
english_hypothesis: With all things considered, we should not be surprised if our ancestors had found a way to solve their "protein problem" to some extent, similar to how modern chimpanzees in the savannah solve theirs.

source: شیرها اجتماعی ترین گربه ها هستند که در گروه های بزرگی به نام غرور زنده گی می کنند.
english_gold: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
english_hypothesis: Lions are the most social of cats, living in large groups called prides.

source: پرایدها از یک تا سه نر بالغ به علاوه سه ماده و ماهی تشکیل شده است.
english_gold: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
english_hypothesis: The group consists of one to three adult males, plus three females and a fish.

source: زنان معمولاً با یکدیگر دارای خویشاوند نزدیک هستند و دارای خانواده ای بزرگ از خواهران و دختران هستند.
english_gold: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
english_hypothesis: Women usually have close relatives among themselves and have a large family of sisters and daughters.

source: طعمه شیر مانند گرگ یا طعمه سگ رفتار می کند، حیوانات به طرز شگفت انگیزی از نظر رفتار شبیه شیرها هستند (اما نه پشک های بزرگ دیگر) و همچنین برای طعمه خود بسیار کشنده هستند.
english_gold: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
english_hypothesis: Lions behave like tigers or wolves when they are hunting, and animals are surprisingly similar to lions in their behavior (although not in their large manes). They are also very deadly to their prey.

source: فاصله بین پوینت ماریون و فیرمونت چالش برانگیزترین شرایط دریوری را در بزرگراه بوفالو-پیتسبورگ به وجود می آورد و اغلب از ساحه جدا افتاده جنگل پشت سر عبور می کند.
english_gold: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
english_hypothesis: The distance between Marion and Fairmont poses the most challenging maritime conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway and often passes through a separate area of the forest.

source: اگر به دریوری در جاده های روستایی عادت ندارید، حواس خود را جمع کنید: شیب های تند، خطوط باریک و پیچ های تیز فراوان است.
english_gold: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
english_hypothesis: If you are not accustomed to driving on rural roads, pay attention: there are many steep inclines, narrow lines, and sharp turns.

source: محدودیت های سرعت نصب شده به شکل قابل توجهی کمتر از بخش های قبلی و بعدی است - معمولاً 35-40 مایل در ساعت (56-64 کیلومتر در ساعت)- و رعایت دقیق از آنها حتی مهمتر از موارد دیگر است.
english_gold: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
english_hypothesis: The speed limits installed are significantly lower than the previous and next sections, typically 35-40 miles per hour (56-64 kilometers per hour), and adhering to them is even more important than other matters.

source: با این حال، عجیب است که خدمات تلیفون موبایل در اینجا بسیار قوی تر از سایر نقاط مسیر، به عنوان مثال پنسیلوانیا وایلدز است.
english_gold: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
english_hypothesis: However, it is strange that mobile phone services here are much stronger than in other parts of the route, for example, Pennsylvania Wilds.

source: دیدن مکان ها و حیات وحش گالاپاگوس بهتر است مانند چارلز داروین در سال 1835 با قایق انجام شود.
english_gold: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.
english_hypothesis: Visiting the Galapagos Islands and its wildlife is better done like Charles Darwin did in 1835, by boat.

source: بیش از 60 کشتی تفریحی در آب های گالاپاگوس رفت و آمد می کنند – این کشتی ها بین 8 تا 100 مسافر ظرفیت دارند.
english_gold: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.
english_hypothesis: More than 60 pleasure boats operate in the waters of the Galapagos Islands, with capacities ranging from 8 to 100 passengers.

source: اکثر مردم جای خود را از قبل رزرو می کنند (زیرا قایق ها در فصل پر آب معمولاً پر هستند).
english_gold: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).
english_hypothesis: Most people book their seats in advance (as the boats are usually full during the peak season).

source: مطمئن گردید نماینده ای که از طریق آن رزرو می کنید متخصص گالاپاگوس است و دانش مناسبی از انواع مختلف کشتی ها دارد.
english_gold: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.
english_hypothesis: You are assured that the representative you are booking through is an expert on the Galapagos and has a good knowledge of various types of ships.

source: این امر مطابقت علایق و/یا محدودیت های خاص شما با مناسبترین کشتی را تضمین می کند.
english_gold: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.
english_hypothesis: This ensures that the chosen vessel aligns with your specific interests and/or constraints.

source: سفر و یادگیری به شکل فزاینده ای یکی از پرطرفدارترین گزینه ها برای کسانی است که سالی خالی را پلان دارند.
english_gold: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
english_hypothesis: Travel and learning are increasingly becoming one of the most popular options for those who plan to take a gap year.

source: این موضوع بخصوص در میان محصلینی که مکتب را تمام می کنند رایج است، و به آنها اجازه می دهد پیش از ورود به پوهنتون بدون اینکه تحصیلاتشان را به خطر بیندازند یک سال را در فراغت باشند.
english_gold: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
english_hypothesis: This phenomenon is common among students who complete their high school education, and allows them to take a year off before entering university without jeopardizing their studies.

source: در بسیاری موارد، ثبت نام در کورسی یک ساله در خارج در حقیقت می تواند شانس هایتان برای ورود به تحصیلات عالی در کشورتان را افزایش دهد.
english_gold: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
english_hypothesis: In many cases, registering for a one-year course abroad can actually increase your chances of getting into higher education in your home country.

source: معمولاً ثبت نام در این برنامه های آموزشی شامل فیس می گردد.
english_gold: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
english_hypothesis: Registration for these educational programs usually includes a fee.

source: بیشتر سفرهای تفریحی خاص بالتیک اقامتی اضافی را در سن پترزبورگ، روسیه دارند.
english_gold: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
english_hypothesis: Most Baltic leisure trips have additional accommodation in St. Petersburg, Russia.

source: این بدان معناست که می توانید هنگام بازگشت برای چند روز مکمل از این شهر تاریخی دیدن نموده و شب را در کشتی بخوابید.
english_gold: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
english_hypothesis: This means you can visit the historic city for a few days on your way back and sleep on the ship.

source: اگر برای رفتن به ساحل فقط از گشت های تفریحی کشتی استفاده می کنید، ضرورت به ویزه جداگانه نخواهید داشت (2009 به بعد).
english_gold: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
english_hypothesis: If you only use pleasure cruises to go to the beach, you will not need a separate visa (after 2009).

source: بعضی از تورهای گردشگری شهر برلین، آلمان را در بروشورها قرار داده اند. همانطور که در نقشه بالا مشاهده می کنید برلین نزدیک به دریا نمی باشد و بازدید از این شهر در هزینه گردش شامل نگردیده است.
english_gold: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
english_hypothesis: Some tourist tours of Berlin, Germany, have included the city in their brochures. As you can see from the map above, Berlin is not near the sea and visiting this city has not been included in the cost of the tour.

source: 1:15 a.m. شنبه، به گفته شاهدین، بس از یک چراغ سبز میگذشت که یک موتر از جلو اش دور زد.
english_gold: At 1:15 a.m. Saturday, according to witnesses, the bus was going through a green light when the car made a turn in front of it.
english_hypothesis: 1:15 a.m. on Saturday, according to eyewitnesses, a car passed by a green light when a car from the front passed by it.

source: خوشبختانه به من هیچ چیزی رخ نداده است، مگر من یک صحنه ترسناک را دیدم، طوریکه مردم کوشش میکردند تا برای بیرون رفتن کلکین ها را بشکند.
english_gold: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.
english_hypothesis: I am fortunate that nothing has happened to me, but I saw a terrifying scene, where people were trying to break the ice to get out.

source: مردم پنجره ها را با چوکی میزدند، مگر کلکین ها غیرقابل شکستن بودند.
english_gold: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.
english_hypothesis: The people were hitting the windows with a hammer, but the panes were unbreakable.

source: یکی از افراد زنده مانده فرانشیک کوال گفت، "یکی از پنجره ها بالاخره شکست، و آنها شروع به خارج شدن از کلکین کردند".
english_gold: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.
english_hypothesis: One of the survivors of the French Quarter said, "One of the windows finally broke, and they started to escape from the attic."

source: موضوع در 1 جنوری زمانیکه ده ها تن از ساکنین محلی شروع به شکایت به دفتر پوست اوبانزاوا کرد اینکه آنها کارت های مروج و همیشه سال نو خویش را دریافت نکرده اند شروع شد.
english_gold: The issue started on January 1st when dozens of local residents started complaining to the Obanazawa Post Office that they hadn't received their traditional and regular New Year cards.
english_hypothesis: The issue began on January 1st when dozens of local residents started complaining to the Obanazawa town office that they had not received their New Year's greeting cards.

source: دیروز، دفتر پوست عذرخواهی خود را به شهروندان نشر نموده و رسانه ها بعد از کشف اینکه پسر بیشتر از 600 سند پوستی بشمول 429 کارت پوستی سال نو را پنهان نموده بود، که به دریافت کنندگان که مد نظر بودند نرسیده بودند.
english_gold: Yesterday, the post office released their apology to citizens and the media after discovering that the boy had hidden more than 600 postal documents, including 429 New Year postcards, which weren't delivered to their intended recipients.
english_hypothesis: Yesterday, the office issued an apology to citizens and media outlets discovered that the boy had hidden over 600 pieces of skin, including 429 New Year's skin cards, which had not reached the intended recipients.

source: مادر گفت، "ما همه مان شوکه شده بودیم".
english_gold: "We were all simply in shock," the mother stated.
english_hypothesis: We were all shocked.

source: زمانیکه پرسیده شد که پدر چه گفت، او گفت که "او هیچ چیز نمیتوانست بگوید – او فقط انجا ایستاده پلک میزد."
english_gold: When asked what the father said, she answered "He couldn't say a thing - he just stood there blinking."
english_hypothesis: When asked what the father said, he replied, "He couldn't say anything – he was just standing there blinking."

source: مسافرانی که در حال برنامه ریزی برای تغییر جنسیت در خارج از کشور هستند، باید اطمینان حاصل کنند مدارکی معتبر برای سفر برگشت دارند.
english_gold: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
english_hypothesis: Travelers planning to undergo gender reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they have valid documents for their return journey.

source: تمایل دولت ها برای صدور پاسپورت با جنسیت نامعین (X) یا اسناد به روز شده برای مطابقت با نام دلخواه و جنسیت متفاوت است.
english_gold: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
english_hypothesis: The governments' preference for issuing passports with an unspecified gender (X) or updated documents to match the desired name and gender is.

source: تمایل دولت های خارجی برای احترام به این اسناد نیز به همان اندازه متغیر است.
english_gold: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
english_hypothesis: The willingness of foreign governments to respect these documents is also variable.

source: افراد تراجنسیتی پیش از عملیات نباید انتظار داشته باشند که عبور از اسکنرها با حفظ حریم خصوصی و حفظ شأن آنها صورت پذیرد.
english_gold: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
english_hypothesis: Individuals who are transgender should not expect to pass through scanners with their privacy and dignity intact before undergoing the operation.

source: غذای هنگی در گودالی داغ داخل زمین پخته می شود.
english_gold: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.
english_hypothesis: Food is cooked in a hole in the ground.

source: این گودال یا با سنگ های داغ ناشی از آتش گرم می شود، یا در برخی نقاط حرارت زمین گرمایی باعث می شود مناطق زمین به طور طبیعی داغ شوند.
english_gold: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.
english_hypothesis: This pit or is heated by hot stones resulting from fire, or in some areas, geothermal heat causes the earth's surface to naturally warm up.

source: هنگی اغلب برای پخت شامی سنتی به سبک کباب استفاده می شود.
english_gold: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.
english_hypothesis: Hing is often used in traditional shami kebabs.

source: چندین مکان در روتوروا هنگی زمین گرمایی را ارائه می دهند، در حالی که سایر هنگی ها را می توان در کرایست چرچ، ولینگتون و جاهای دیگر خورد.
english_gold: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.
english_hypothesis: Several hot springs can be found in Rotorua, while others are located in Christchurch, Wellington, and other places.

source: Cinque Terre که به معنی پنج سرزمین است، از پنج روستای ساحلی کوچک ریماگیور، مانارولا، کورنگلیا، ویرنازا و مونتیروسو واقع در قسمت لاتین لیگوریا شکل یافته است.
english_gold: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.
english_hypothesis: The Cinque Terre, which translates to "five lands," is a coastal area formed by the five small towns of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza, and Monterosso, located in the Liguria region.

source: آنها در لست میراث های جهانی یونسکو قرار گرفته اند.
english_gold: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
english_hypothesis: They are listed as UNESCO World Heritage sites.

source: طی قرن ها، مردم بالکن هایی بهاری را با دقت بر روی چشم انداز ناهموار و شیب دار صخره هایی که مشرف به دریا هستند ساخته اند.
english_gold: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.
english_hypothesis: For centuries, people have built balconies with a spring view on the rugged and sloping rocks overlooking the sea with great care.

source: عدم انکشاف متحد قابل مشاهده جزیی از جذابیت آن است. مسیرها، قطارها و قایق ها قریه جات را به هم متصل نموده و موترها از بیرون نمی توانند به آنجا برسند.
english_gold: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.
english_hypothesis: The lack of development and infrastructure is a significant part of its charm. The roads, trains, and boats connect the villages and cars cannot reach there from outside.

source: محمد عمیقاً به مسایلی فراتر از این زندگی روزمره علاقه مند بود. او برای اندیشیدن در غاری که بنام <حرا> در کوه "نور" (شرونی) معروف شد رفت و آمد می کرد.
english_gold: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
english_hypothesis: Mohammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He would often visit a cave known as "Harra" in the mountain of "Nur" (Shurani) to ponder and reflect.

source: خود غار که از زمان ها سالم مانده است، نمای خیلی واضحی از گرایشات معنوی محمد به دست می دهد.
english_gold: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
english_hypothesis: This cave, which has remained intact through the ages, provides a very clear indication of Muhammad's spiritual inclinations.

source: این غار که در قسمت بالای یکی از کوه های شمال مکه قرار دارد، کاملاً از دیگر نقاط جهان مجزا بنظر میرسد.
english_gold: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
english_hypothesis: This cave, located at the top of one of the northern mountains of Mecca, appears completely isolated from other parts of the world.

source: چیزی جز آسمان صاف و زیبای بالا و کوه های متعدد اطراف آن دیده نمی شود. خیلی کم از این دنیا را می توان از داخل غار دید یا شنید.
english_gold: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
english_hypothesis: Nothing is seen but the clear and beautiful sky above and the numerous mountains surrounding it. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from within a cave.

source: از آنجا که مونته ویدئو در جنوب خط استوا قرار دارد، زمانی که در نیمکره شمالی زمستان است در آنجا تابستان می باشد و برعکس.
english_gold: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
english_hypothesis: Montevideo, being located in the southern hemisphere, experiences summer when it is winter in the northern hemisphere and vice versa.

source: مونته ویدئو در منطقه نیمه گرمسیری قرار دارد. معمولاً در ماه های تابستان دما 30+ درجه سانتی گراد است.
english_gold: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
english_hypothesis: Monte Video is located in the subtropics. The temperature usually reaches 30+ degrees Celsius during the summer months.

source: زمستان می تواند به طرز فریبنده ای سرد باشد: درجه حرارت به ندرت به زیر صفر می رسد، اما ترکیب باد و رطوبت باعث می شود سرما نسبت به درجه نمایش داده شده روی دماسنج سردتر احساس گردد.
english_gold: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
english_hypothesis: Winter can be deceptively cold: the temperature rarely drops below zero, but the combination of wind and humidity makes the cold feel even colder than the reading on the thermometer indicates.

source: هیچ فصل بارانی و خشک خاصی وجود ندارد: میزان بارندگی در طول سال تقریباً یکسان است.
english_gold: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
english_hypothesis: There is no specific rainy or dry season: the amount of rainfall throughout the year is almost uniform.

source: ورزش های برفی در سراشیبی، که شامل اسکی و اسنوبورد است، ورزش های پرطرفداری هستند که شامل سر خوردن روی زمین های پوشیده از برف با اسکی یا اسنوبورد چسبیده به پاهایتان است.
english_gold: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
english_hypothesis: Snow sports on the slopes, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports that involve sliding on snow-covered grounds with skis or snowboards attached to your feet.

source: اسکی یک فعالیت اصلی مسافرتی با تعداد زیادی علاقمند است، گاهی اوقات به عنوان "بوم اسکی"، پلان ریزی برای تمامی تعطیلات حول محور اسکی در یک مکان خاص شناخته میشود.
english_gold: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
english_hypothesis: Skiing is a popular recreational activity with a large number of enthusiasts, sometimes referred to as "ski tourism," where planning for all vacations revolves around skiing in a specific location.

source: نظریه اسکی سواری بسیار قدیمی است - نگاره های مغاره ای که اسکی بازان را نمایش میدهد به 5000 سال قبل از میلاد باز می گردد!
english_gold: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
english_hypothesis: The theory of skiing is very old - cave paintings depicting skiers date back to 5000 years before the birth of Christ!

source: اسکی در سراشیبی به عنوان یک سپورت حداقل به قرن 17 برمی گردد و در سال 1861 اولین کلب اسکی تفریحی توسط نروژی ها در استرالیا افتتاح شد.
english_gold: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
english_hypothesis: Skiing as a sport dates back to at least the 17th century, and the first ski club for recreational skiing was established by Norwegians in Australia in 1861.

source: نوشیدنی های الکلی را در حد اعتدال بنوشید. مشروبات الکلی تاثیر متفاوت روی افراد می گذارد، و دانستن حد خود بسیار مهم است.
english_gold: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.
english_hypothesis: Drink alcoholic beverages in moderation. The effects of alcohol can vary from person to person, and knowing your limits is crucial.

source: کازینوها معمولاً تلاش بسیاری می کنند تا زمان و پول صرف شده توسط مهمانان را به حداکثر برسانند. معمولا کلکین و ساعت وجود ندارند، و یافتن خروجی ها دشوار است.
english_gold: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
english_hypothesis: Casinos usually try to maximize the time and money spent by guests. They usually do not have clocks or watches, and finding the exits is difficult.

source: آنها معمولاً پیشنهادات غذایی، نوشیدنی و سرگرمی خاص دارند تا مهمانان را در خلق و خوی خوب نگاه داشته و در تعمیر حفظ دارند.
english_gold: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
english_hypothesis: They usually have special food, drink, and entertainment suggestions to keep guests in a good mood and maintain their comfort.

source: برخی از مکان ها نوشیدنی های الکلی رایگان ارائه می دهند. با این حال، مستی قضاوت را مختل می کند و تمام قماربازان خوب اهمیت هوشیار بودن را می دانند.
english_gold: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
english_hypothesis: Some places offer free alcoholic drinks. However, intoxication impairs judgment, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
